shows.name: Industry
shows.overview: In the cutthroat world of international finance, a group of young graduates compete for a limited set of permanent positions at a top investment bank in London. The boundaries between colleague, friend, lover, and enemy soon blur as they immerse themselves in a company culture defined as much by sex, drugs and ego as it is by deals and dividends.

episodes.name: Induction
episodes.overview: Five young graduates do whatever it takes to make themselves indispensable at preeminent London investment bank Pierpoint & Co. As hungry outsider Harper grapples with a decision that will gravely affect her future at the bank, she and party-boy Robert take very different approaches to their first few weeks in the bank. Meanwhile, Yasmin braves the unchecked disrespect of her superiors and Hari’s unhealthy work habits raise companywide red flags.

episodes.name: Quiet and Nice
episodes.overview: With Harper struggling to find her feet in a new city, Pierpoint throws a morale-boosting appreciation dinner which sees her challenging a drunken, irate Kenny, while Gus alienates senior management by discussing his team’s future. Meanwhile, Yasmin comes face to face with the culture of her new team and takes her flirtation with Robert to risky new heights.

episodes.name: Notting Hill
episodes.overview: When Pierpoint loses a major client, the grads face their most challenging – and potentially rewarding – test to date: devising pitches to drive new business. After the dissolution of his team finds him reassigned to a disinterested new supervisor, a creative Gus partners with Robert to catch Clement’s attention. Meanwhile, as she navigates a complicated living situation with Yasmin, Harper attempts to juggle conflicting requests from Eric and Daria.

episodes.name: Sesh
episodes.overview: After a wild birthday celebration with Robert, Yasmin, and Greg, Harper’s workday spirals out of control. As a discrepancy in one of her trades puts her team at risk for major losses, Harper seeks support from a surprising source, while unexpected trouble at a networking event brings Yasmin and Robert closer and Gus further alienates his coworkers.

episodes.name: Learned Behaviour
episodes.overview: As Pierpoint is shaken by a former employee's scathing exposé, Eric goes offsite for the day, prompting an unauthorized Gus to cover trades from his desk, while Harper maneuvers her way into a meeting with one of Eric's coveted, disgruntled ex-clients. But when Gus and Harper both cross the line, they risk compromising their futures at the bank. Following Robert's successful first business trip, Clement  treats him to a special outing, while Yasmin works her connections to land a major client meeting.

episodes.name: Nutcracker
episodes.overview: Sex, drugs, and secrets light up Pierpoint’s annual holiday party, where Maxim’s unexpected arrival aggravates tensions between Yasmin and Kenny, and Greg finds himself in a painful predicament after partying a little too hard with Robert and Usman. After confiding in Daria, Harper is blindsided by a meeting with Sara, the president of the London office.

episodes.name: Pre-Crisis Activity
episodes.overview: With Reduction in Force Day looming, the graduates do whatever it takes to secure final recommendations from their superiors and solidify vital client relationships. At a dinner party hosted by Yasmin and Sebastian, resentment and jealousy bubble to the surface, and Harper divulges confidential company business.

episodes.name: Reduction in Force
episodes.overview: After a tumultuous few months at Pierpoint, the graduates take vastly different approaches as they stand before senior management to prove they’re worthy of permanent positions. Following an unexpected meeting with a familiar face, Harper contends with a decision that could transform the culture of Pierpoint.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The cutthroat world of international finance is seen through the eyes of a talented outsider fighting to prove her worth. Harper Stern, a determined young woman, finds herself among a group of enterprising young graduates vying to secure their futures at Pierpoint & Co., a leading bank in London.

episodes.name: Daddy
episodes.overview: Finally forced to return to the office, Harper confronts a rapidly intensifying atmosphere under Pierpoint’s new U.S. leadership, while Robert attempts to hook a client and Yasmin receives pushback from her young recruit.

episodes.name: The Giant Squid
episodes.overview: Harper’s decision to pursue Bloom over Felim exposes larger issues between her and Eric — and the account. Meanwhile, Yasmin pitches herself for an exciting new opportunity just as her estranged father Charles suddenly reemerges, and Robert takes his pursuit of Nicole to another level.

episodes.name: The Fool
episodes.overview: The high of landing Bloom soon wears off when Harper suddenly finds herself stuck between rivals at Rican Healthcare’s investor event — and at the mercy of Eric’s frustration. After attempting to lure her father’s business, Yasmin is forced to curry favor with Celeste. Meanwhile, unexpected doors open for Gus while tutoring Bloom’s son, Leo.

episodes.name: There Are Some Women...
episodes.overview: Reeling from the Felim fallout, Eric takes some time to reassess his next move — which later finds him on a plane to New York. While continuing to reap the rewards of closing Bloom as a client, Harper begins to grow closer to Danny. As she moves towards managing her family's money, Yasmin learns some startling truths about her father.

episodes.name: Kitchen Season
episodes.overview: After learning of Yasmin and Jackie's impending trip to Berlin, Harper attempts to land an invite for more than just business reasons. Approached about a new government position, Aurore offers a conflicted Gus a spot on her team. Meanwhile, Danny asks Robert to pursue a recent grad for a position at Pierpoint.

episodes.name: Short to the Point of Pain
episodes.overview: When a group of online traders attempts a short squeeze of FastAide, Bloom takes it personally, while a recently AWOL Harper suddenly fears the future of their working relationship. As Gus grows increasingly conflicted about Aurore's job offer, Yasmin navigates a major transition.

episodes.name: Lone Wolf and Cub
episodes.overview: After receiving confirmation that the London office will merge with New York, Harper, Eric, and Rishi team up to pitch their small global force to rival banks. Just as Yasmin readies herself for her first client meeting in her new role, she becomes engulfed in a pressing issue at Pierpoint. Meanwhile, Gus leverages an opportunity for Leo.

episodes.name: Jerusalem
episodes.overview: As she chases a life-changing opportunity at Shogun, Harper receives an unexpected test from Bloom. Still shocked by her response to Venetia, Yasmin has a reckoning with Celeste, her father, and the future she imagined for herself. Meanwhile, Gus pursues his next move, and Robert reaches out to a surprising source for help.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Picking up a year after the height of the pandemic, Season 2 finds the young professionals at Pierpoint & Co's London office dealing with a back to work or else mandate that leaves the trading floor more charged than ever. But to edge out the competition, Harper, Yasmin, and the other third-year analysts must drive new business and forge alliances both in and out of the office.

episodes.name: Il Mattino ha L'Oro Bocca
episodes.overview: As Pierpoint preps for an IPO, Yasmin tries to defy assumptions, Robert mismanages Lumi’s CEO, and Harper plots to get back in the game.

episodes.name: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.overview: Following a bumpy launch, Eric scrambles to maintain control over the floor and ensure Lumi's IPO is a success. Meanwhile, Harper forms a new work alliance, Robert suffers a devastating loss, and Yasmin’s ingenuity wins Henry’s attention.

episodes.name: It
episodes.overview: Eric, Yasmin, and Robert descend on the COP Climate Conference in Switzerland to display Pierpoint’s confidence in pivoting to ethical investing, where Harper's machinations threaten to disrupt the status quo.

episodes.name: White Mischief
episodes.overview: Deeply in debt with a new home and baby, Rishi takes a massive gamble after a surprise visit from an old friend. Later, with his luck running out both at home and work, Rishi engages in another high-risk, high-reward opportunity that could threaten his job at Pierpoint.

episodes.name: Company Man
episodes.overview: After being summoned by a government select committee, Robert worries he’s become a pawn in a much larger battle between very powerful entities. Meanwhile, during the company’s annual charity day, Sweetpea shares a theory with Eric that could mark the beginning of the end for Pierpoint, and Yasmin wonders if being vulnerable in a relationship is worth it.

episodes.name: Nikki Beach, or: So Many Ways to Lose
episodes.overview: Invigorated by LeviathanAlpha’s success, Harper pitches an idea to Petra that finds them visiting London’s top financial institutions—including Pierpoint. Later, Yasmin leans on Harper when her world is upended by catastrophic news.

episodes.name: Useful Idiot
episodes.overview: When disaster strikes during Pierpoint’s 150th anniversary celebration, Eric is summoned to the executive boardroom, while Rishi, Sweetpea, and Anraj try to save their own skins on the trading floor. Across town, Harper’s risky moves jeopardize LeviathanAlpha, while Yasmin escapes on a road trip with Robert.

episodes.name: Infinite Largesse
episodes.overview: After a long night, Eric and Pierpoint’s executives find a solution that could bring new changes – and consequences – for the company. Meanwhile, Yasmin and Robert pay a fated visit to the countryside, and Harper’s career ambitions lead her to a crossroads.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In season three, as Pierpoint looks to the future and takes a big bet on ethical investing, Yasmin, Robert, and Eric find themselves front and center in the splashy IPO of Lumi, a green tech energy company led by Sir Henry Muck, in a story that runs all the way to the very top of finance, media, and government. Since leaving Pierpoint, Harper is eager to get back into the addictive thrill of finance and finds an unlikely partner in FutureDawn portfolio manager Petra Koenig.

episodes.name: PayPal of Bukkake
episodes.overview: While Harper makes a bold move as head of her own fund, Whitney Halberstram works to ensure the successful evolution of Tender.

episodes.name: The Commander and the Grey Lady
episodes.overview: As Yasmin brings the industry to Henry for his birthday party, Harper takes the opportunity to learn more about Whitney.

episodes.name: Habseligkeiten
episodes.overview: As Harper and Eric embark on a new partnership, Yasmin and Henry find the lines between business and pleasure beginning to blur.

episodes.name: 1000 Yoots, 1 Marilyn
episodes.overview: While Whitney and Henry pursue a new partner for Tender's banking app, Harper gambles on an exposé of the company's business practices.

episodes.name: Eyes Without a Face
episodes.overview: With the company's position collapsing, Sweetpea and Kwabena head to Accra to try to expose Tender's acquisition strategy with Whitney's right-hand man, Tony Day. Meanwhile, Harper and Eric get blindsided by personal news.

episodes.name: Dear Henry
episodes.overview: Harper warns Yasmin of the incoming storm amid preparations to present SternTao's findings at the ALPHA Conference. Meanwhile, Whitney looks to expand Tender to the U.S. as he distracts Henry from his growing suspicions.

episodes.name: Points of Emphasis
episodes.overview: After a surprising revelation, Yasmin and Henry must decide on their next move. Whitney continues to eye expansion, and Harper and Eric make strategic decisions for the fund.

episodes.name: Both, And
episodes.overview: As Tender dominates the headlines, Yasmin seizes the chance at a new opportunity, while Henry considers whether to challenge the status quo. While Whitney scrambles for a way out, Harper faces a moment of reckoning.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: At the top of their game and living the lives they set out to have as Pierpoint grads, Harper and Yasmin are drawn into a high stakes, globetrotting cat-and-mouse game when a splashy fintech darling bursts onto the London scene. As Yasmin navigates her relationship with tech founder Sir Henry Muck and Harper is pulled into the orbit of enigmatic executive Whitney Halberstram, their twisted friendship begins to warp and ignite under the pressure of money, power, and the desire to be on top.

shows.name: Liocracy
shows.overview:
Liocracy was a Canadian television comedy series, which aired on The Comedy Network in 2001 and 2002.

The show, a spoof of biographical documentary series such as Biography or Life and Times, starred Leslie Nielsen as host Terrence Brynne McKennie. Each episode presented a Biography-type profile of a fictional person loosely based on a real-life celebrity.

The show was originally titled Liography, but was changed to Liocracy when the A&E Network, the producers of the original Biography series, threatened a copyright infringement lawsuit.

episodes.overview: Love is not in the air in Ice Cove as Siaja re-enters the dating world in epic style, Neevee and Alistair reach a turning point, and Kuuk has a surprise visitor.

episodes.name: Lost and Found
episodes.overview: The community comes together for an exhausting multi-day search for Ting. Siaja entrusts Alistair to babysit Bun during the search.

episodes.name: Bad Influences
episodes.overview: Siaja and Helen put the final touches on their pitch for the polar research station, when Helen is pulled away. Siaja uses this opportunity to view the only available apartment in town with Kuuk’s help.

shows.name: Only Murders in the Building
shows.overview: Three strangers share an obsession with true crime and suddenly find themselves wrapped up in one.

episodes.name: True Crime
episodes.overview: Upper West Side neighbors Charles, Oliver & Mabel bond over a shared love of true crime. When a fellow resident dies in their building, the trio determine to solve the mystery and record an accompanying podcast.

episodes.name: Who Is Tim Kono?
episodes.overview: The group begins researching the victim. Meanwhile, Mabel’s secretive past starts to be unraveled.

episodes.name: How Well Do You Know Your Neighbors?
episodes.overview: Oliver employs his theater director skills to analyze the case. Charles & Mabel question an obsessive cat lover.

episodes.name: The Sting
episodes.overview: Believing the murderer might be a famous resident whom is difficult to access, the group seeks advice from a renowned podcasting host.

episodes.name: Twist
episodes.overview: Mabel slips away on a solo mission tracking the victim's final days. Suspicious, Charles & Oliver follow her.

episodes.name: To Protect and Serve
episodes.overview: Mabel brings her new friends (and an old one) to her childhood home to meet her mother. Meanwhile, Detective Williams starts to have her own doubts about the case as she prepares for motherhood.

episodes.name: The Boy from 6B
episodes.overview: With the investigation scratching at a web of old crimes originating inside the building, a mysterious young man turns the tables to spy on Charles, Oliver & Mabel.

episodes.name: Fan Fiction
episodes.overview: Hitting a dead end, the group calls for reinforcements in the form of their podcast’s Superfans.

episodes.name: Double Time
episodes.overview: With the residents growing upset at the building’s negative publicity, the trio faces a revolt. Charles is visited by an old colleague who sheds light on his past.

episodes.name: Open and Shut
episodes.overview: In the season finale, the trio races toward a resolution while their own lives are put in danger.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a grisly death occurs inside their exclusive Upper West Side apartment building, three strangers who share an obsession with true crime suspect murder and employ their precise knowledge of true crime to investigate the truth. As they record a podcast of their own to document the case, the three unravel the complex secrets of the building which stretch back years. Perhaps even more explosive are the lies they tell one another. Soon, the endangered trio comes to realize a killer might be living amongst them as they race to decipher the mounting clues before it’s too late.

episodes.name: Persons of Interest
episodes.overview: Welcome home, Arconiacs!  Minutes after Season 1’s finale, Charles, Oliver and Mabel are now implicated in the murder of Board President, Bunny Folger.  They must choose whether to lay low or risk their safety by catching the killer themselves.

episodes.name: Framed
episodes.overview: A memorial for Bunny provides an opportunity for our trio to question their neighbors, while they also try to get rid of a very implicating piece of evidence.  One of Bunny’s relatives makes an appearance and if you thought Bunny was a force, get ready...

episodes.name: The Last Day of Bunny Folger
episodes.overview: A foul-mouthed parrot becomes a critical window into Bunny Folger’s last day on Earth.  Some of the individuals with whom Bunny crossed paths will surprise both you and our trio... Along the way, a reveal deepens our trio's need to solve Bunny's case.

episodes.name: Here's Looking at You
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver and Mabel welcome an unexpected young visitor who reveals hidden secrets about the inner workings of the Arconia.  We also discover Charles once recorded a hit single that was huge in Germany.

episodes.name: The Tell
episodes.overview: Mabel hosts a party for an electric art crowd which also serves a double purpose for smoking on a liar in the trios’s midst.

episodes.name: Performance Review
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver and Mabel collide with their podcasting mentor-turned-competitor, Cinda Canning.  Subsequently, a key clue requires the trio to orchestrate a classic stakeout — Brazzos-style.  New York has never been more glittering.

episodes.name: Flipping the Pieces
episodes.overview: Mabel’s incident on the subway leads her to gain help from an unlikely ally.  Their journey takes them to a legendary amusement park which turns out to be full of terror — while amusements and evidence reside back in the Arconia with Charles and Oliver.

episodes.name: Hello, Darkness
episodes.overview: A blackout throws the city into chaos.  As the trio races to save a loved one from the killer, other Arconia residents begin to explore unexpected connections in the midst of darkness — all enhanced by Gut Milk and a yodel or two.

episodes.name: Sparring Partners
episodes.overview: Closing in on the killer, Mabel takes her investigative talents into the ring.  Oliver and Charles duke it out over a birdcage only to end up confronting their deepest paternal struggles.

episodes.name: I Know Who Did It
episodes.overview: One question remains: Who did it??? Oh, who are we kidding -- there's a few more questions raised, too.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 picks up with the trio following the shocking death of Arconia Board President Bunny Folger, as they race to unmask her killer. However, three (unfortunate) complications ensue—the trio is publicly implicated in Bunny’s homicide, they are now the subjects of a competing podcast, and they have to deal with a bunch of New York neighbors who all think they committed murder.

episodes.name: The Show Must...
episodes.overview: Curtain up on Season 3! And Leading Man down! After Ben Glenroy's collapse on stage, Charles, Oliver & Mabel piece together the show’s first days with a suspicious cast & crew to determine if foul play was involved. Spoiler alert...

episodes.name: The Beat Goes On
episodes.overview: Mabel, Oliver & Charles attend Ben’s lavish memorial full of fans and those with more dubious motives. As the actor's sudden death is mourned, Oliver works to revive his shaky Broadway show.

episodes.name: Grab Your Hankies
episodes.overview: Oliver races to bring new life to his show as Mabel’s investigation into the actual murder collides with a surprising ally. Charles bonds with the cast, and Loretta proves her voice is invaluable.

episodes.name: The White Room
episodes.overview: Charles’s stage fright reaches unimaginable heights, involving a break from reality and multiple baby dolls. Mabel is confronted by a mysterious individual from her past with a pivotal proposal.

episodes.name: Ah, Love!
episodes.overview: Date night! New York proves itself both a jewel box and a fish tank of romance as Charles, Mabel & Oliver take their relationships to the next stage. And dating can reveal many hidden secrets, too...

episodes.name: Ghost Light
episodes.overview: All roads lead the trio back to the Goosebury Theater during a nerve-rattling thunderstorm. With Howard as their jittery guide, they track a legendary ghost who’s haunted the theater for generations. Boo.

episodes.name: CoBro
episodes.overview: Charles finds an unexpected source for a major clue. A Broadway icon comes knocking at Oliver’s door. And Mabel forms an alternate trio to pursue a lead that sheds light on Ben’s bro and CoBro history.

episodes.name: Sitzprobe
episodes.overview: On the day of the show’s most critical rehearsal, the pressure mounts. A familiar official returns to upend the case, Loretta’s complex past threatens to upend all else and Charles must finally sing his number without losing his marbles.

episodes.name: Thirty
episodes.overview: The trio have amassed a plethora (oh yes, a plethora) of clues, suspects & theories but find no concrete answers about Ben’s murder. They devise a peculiar method of throwing themselves into the actual case to recreate the final moments of Ben’s life.

episodes.name: Opening Night
episodes.overview: Curtain call on Season 3! Charles, Mabel & Oliver race to entrap the killer on Opening Night. As the musical thrills its Broadway audience, the trio brave further twists & turns from behind, above and all around the stage.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season three finds Charles, Oliver & Mabel investigating a murder behind the scenes of a Broadway show. Ben Glenroy is a Hollywood action star whose Broadway debut is cut short by his untimely death. Aided by co-star Loretta Durkin, our trio embarks on their toughest case yet, all while director Oliver desperately attempts to put his show back together. Curtain up!

episodes.name: Once Upon a Time in the West
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel are whisked to Los Angeles where a legendary film studio intends to adapt their podcast. However, Hollywood's glitz is overshadowed by a stunning clue about Charles' stunt double & friend Sazz Pataki.

episodes.name: Gates of Heaven
episodes.overview: Mabel & Oliver begin investigating Arconia's West Tower and get trapped inside an ominous game. Meanwhile, Charles is visited by two individuals from his complex past.

episodes.name: Two for the Road
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel begrudgingly pair off with new investigators... actors Eugene Levy, Zach Galifianakis & Eva Longoria.

episodes.name: The Stunt Man
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel delve into the particular universe of stunt people. They encounter a suspect with an incredibly... familiar... face.

episodes.name: Adaptation
episodes.overview: The trio face off against a collection of individuals who deceive, manipulate, and threaten as second nature - a Hollywood cast & crew.

episodes.name: Blow-Up
episodes.overview: A documentary film is made by The Brothers Sisters.

episodes.name: Valley of the Dolls
episodes.overview: Terrified by a threat inside the Arconia, the trio race out of the city. A member of Charles' family provides refuge and yet, this safe house proves to be anything but.

episodes.name: Lifeboat
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel combine forces with the film actors in an epic showdown against the Westies. You can't handle the truth.

episodes.name: Escape from Planet Klongo
episodes.overview: Seeking a critical clue, Charles, Oliver & Mabel must infiltrate a film set to get the real "background" on why Sazz was killed.

episodes.name: My Best Friend's Wedding
episodes.overview: The final answers to our season are revealed - but not before the trio faces mortal danger and an Arconia wedding.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The trio investigates the mysterious murder of Sazz Pataki, Charles' stunt double, whose death raises questions about whether Sazz or Charles was the intended victim. The Arconia residents find themselves entangled in Hollywood drama as a studio adapts their podcast into a movie, leading to new faces and on-set chaos. As the action ramps up, the amateur sleuths return to New York, diving into the twisted lives of the Arconia's West Tower residents.

episodes.name: Nail in the Coffin
episodes.overview: While investigating Lester’s mysterious "accidental" death, the clues lure Charles, Oliver, and Mabel out of Manhattan — and straight into some dangerous new "old" territory.

episodes.name: After You
episodes.overview: A look back at Lester's early days at the Arconia reveals how a young dreamer became a steadfast doorman — sacrificing his future to protect the residents from the building’s secrets.

episodes.name: Rigor
episodes.overview: The trio stumbles upon a crucial piece of evidence... and promptly compromises it. With time running out, they scramble to solve the mystery before the police close in on them.

episodes.name: Dirty Birds
episodes.overview: Snooping goes sideways when three billionaire suspects catch the trio and invite themselves over for an evening at Oliver's.

episodes.name: Tongue Tied
episodes.overview: Thwarted in their investigative podcast plans, Mabel and Oliver look for help from the Arconia support staff — as Charles dines with another suspect and gets caught up in "catching" more than he bargained for.

episodes.name: Flatbush
episodes.overview: The investigation takes Oliver and Loretta back to the streets of his childhood, where buried memories surface and secrets about Lester and Nicky's widows emerge. Mabel and Charles follow leads after a break-in.

episodes.name: Silver Alert
episodes.overview: The mayor warns the trio about the billionaires, sending them to investigate further at a villainous lair upstate — as Oliver boots it in an attempted escape.

episodes.name: Cuckoo Chicks
episodes.overview: Mabel gathers a ragtag group to crash an exclusive ladies night. While trying to save the Arconia from being sold, Charles and Oliver accidentally end up in couples' therapy.

episodes.name: LESTR
episodes.overview: Told through the lens of one annoying robot who may hold the keys to more secrets than anyone realized — the Arconia throws one last party as the residents discover that a killer may still be in their building.

episodes.name: The House Always...
episodes.overview: With the clock ticking, the trio doubles down to bring "new" and "old" forces together to bring down a killer — ending in one explosive showdown and the reveals they've been chasing all season.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: After their beloved doorman, Lester, dies under suspicious circumstances, Charles, Oliver, and Mabel refuse to believe it was an accident. Their investigation plunges them into the shadowy corners of New York and beyond - where the trio uncovers a dangerous web of secrets connecting powerful billionaires, old-school mobsters, and the mysterious residents of the Arconia. The trio discovers a deeper divide between their storied city they thought they knew and the new New York evolving around them - one where the old mob fights to hold on as newer, even more dangerous players emerge.

episodes.overview: A desperate scramble for help lands John B and Sarah in questionable surroundings. Pope receives a mysterious summons to an out-of-town meeting.

episodes.overview: Low on gas and strapped for cash, John B and Sarah run into trouble. Pope's appointment in Charleston takes an ominous turn over a proposed trade.

episodes.overview: John B bristles when Sarah reconnects with a former flame. Ward's web of lies starts to unravel. Pope discovers a shocking family secret.

episodes.overview: Reeling from Ward's actions, Sarah finds her loyalties to John B and the Pogues put to the test. At the annual bonfire, jealousies and tempers flare.

episodes.overview: Armed with new clues, the group braves perilous roads and swampland as they race to keep part of Pope's history from falling into the wrong hands.

episodes.overview: The Pogues deal with a slew of setbacks — a medical emergency, a nosy neighbor, parental ultimatums — as they attempt to save Pope's family legacy.

episodes.name: The Coastal Venture
episodes.overview: John B, Pope, JJ and Kiara brace for a showdown on board the ship, while Sarah realizes the harsh truth of her distressing family situation.

episodes.name: Poguelandia
episodes.overview: An unexpected rescuer takes the Pogues from a remote island to Barbados, where they encounter a powerful treasure hunter with his own agenda.

episodes.name: The Bells
episodes.overview: As her friends mount a rescue attempt, Kiara agrees to an uneasy truce with Rafe. A familiar sound grabs John B's attention.

episodes.name: Fathers and Sons
episodes.overview: Big John and John B pick up where they left off — for better or worse. Cleo and Pope form a new club. Rafe reconnects with Ward.

episodes.name: The Diary
episodes.overview: An emotional homecoming is easier for some than others. Big John searches for the diary. Ward's plans for a prized possession don't sit well with Rafe.

episodes.name: Heists
episodes.overview: Sarah convinces an old friend to help with a high-risk, high-reward mission. Looking to access a museum collection, John B and his dad get creative.

episodes.name: The Dark Forest
episodes.overview: Secrets threaten to drive a wedge between John B and his friends. Sarah revisits a past life. Pope reaches a breaking point.

episodes.name: Happy Anniversary
episodes.overview: With Singh on the move, John B and JJ scramble to catch him. Pope makes a breakthrough. Sarah questions where her loyalties lie.

episodes.name: Tapping the Rudder
episodes.overview: Rafe lays his cards on the table and Sarah calls in two favors. JJ's unorthodox plan to get to South America lands John B in hot water.

episodes.name: Welcome to Kitty Hawk
episodes.overview: With their ride to Orinoco waiting on the tarmac, Kiara and JJ run into several complications. Rafe has a change of heart.

episodes.name: Secret of the Gnomon
episodes.overview: The Pogues' search for El Dorado brings them deep into the jungle, where John B and Sarah face the ultimate test of their courage and family bonds.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: New adventures take the Pogues to the Caribbean and far beyond as the friends are pulled into a dangerous rival's hunt for a legendary lost city.

episodes.name: The Enduro
episodes.overview: Flush with success, the Pogues have big plans to invest in their future. But when their fortunes take a turn, will a bold gamble pay off?

episodes.name: Blackbeard
episodes.overview: A strange tale of a family curse makes the Pogues think twice about accepting a lucrative offer to search for an amulet linked to Blackbeard.

episodes.name: The Lupine Corsairs
episodes.overview: The sheriff grills the Pogues about their dealings with Wes Genrette. JJ and Kiara have another close call. Pope gets wind of a mysterious artifact.

episodes.name: The Swell
episodes.overview: Tensions rise along with the waves when the Pogues and the Kooks hit the beach for the year's best swell. As Pope digs for info, Cleo faces down danger.

episodes.name: Albatross
episodes.overview: The Pogues scramble when the sheriff turns up at the worst possible time. JJ receives a mysterious letter. The amulet's clues point to Charleston.

episodes.name: The Town Council
episodes.overview: JJ learns about his past. The Pogues rally support for a zoning meeting that will decide their fate. Sarah and John B suss out a theory about the scroll.

episodes.name: Mothers and Fathers
episodes.overview: As a confrontation on Goat Island turns perilous, Sarah confirms a suspicion while searching for JJ, Pope's future falters, and Topper taunts John B.

episodes.name: Family Plot
episodes.overview: While JJ heads out on a grim mission with Groff, Sarah reveals her big news, Pope faces a moment of truth, and Rafe helps the sheriff connect the dots.

episodes.name: The Storm
episodes.overview: Pursued by police, the Pogues embark on the next stage of their mission with help from an unexpected source. Tensions flare when John B confides in JJ.

episodes.name: The Blue Crown
episodes.overview: The hunt for Groff heats up in Morocco. In a deadly race to claim the crown, loyalties are tested — and a moment of treachery changes everything.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After Camp Half-Blood's protective border is breached, Percy Jackson embarks on an epic odyssey into the Sea of Monsters in search of his best friend, the satyr Grover Underwood, and the one thing that may save the camp — the legendary Golden Fleece. Aided by demigods Annabeth Chase and Clarisse La Rue, along with his cyclops half-brother Tyson, Percy's survival becomes the key to preventing Luke and the Titan Kronos from bringing down Camp Half-Blood — and, ultimately, Olympus.

shows.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians

last_episode_to_air.overview: Finch, Reese, Fusco and Shaw embark on one last mission to prevent Samaritan from destroying The Machine and cementing its hold over mankind.

shows.name: Person of Interest
shows.overview: John Reese, former CIA paramilitary operative, is presumed dead and teams up with reclusive billionaire Finch to prevent violent crimes in New York City by initiating their own type of justice. With the special training that Reese has had in Covert Operations and Finch's genius software inventing mind, the two are a perfect match for the job that they have to complete. With the help of surveillance equipment, they work "outside the law" and get the right criminal behind bars.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: When the social security number of a young prosecutor comes up, Reese and Finch work together to figure out if their person of interest is the victim or perpetrator.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch question the machine's reliability when they are asked to investigate a teenager who was killed years earlier; Finch remembers the origin of the machine.

episodes.name: Mission Creep
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover to find the threat surrounding the next person on Finch's list: a young army veteran named Joey Durban.

episodes.name: Cura Te Ipsum
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch get some help from Detective Fusco  as they surveil their latest POI, Dr. Megan Tillman, while she’s on call and after hours to unravel the threat surrounding the promising young physician.

episodes.name: Judgement
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch have the added challenge of investigating a Person of Interest who wants nothing to do with their brand of vigilante justice.

episodes.name: The Fix
episodes.overview: Reese becomes romantically involved with the newest Person of Interest: an attractive woman who isn't all that she seems.

episodes.name: Witness
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies a school teacher who witnessed a mob hit as their next POI and Reese and Finch rush to save his life.

episodes.name: Foe
episodes.overview: When Reese and Finch discover that their latest POI has connections to Cold War Soviet espionage circles, they quickly learn how covert ops were handled in a world before The Machine.

episodes.name: Get Carter
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch’s game of cat and mouse with Detective Carter becomes infinitely more complicated when The Machine declares that she is their newest POI.

episodes.name: Number Crunch
episodes.overview: As Detective Carter deals with the fallout from her recent encounter with Reese and Finch, The Machine ups the ante for the duo by giving them four Social Security numbers instead of one.

episodes.name: Super
episodes.overview: Reese is confined to a wheelchair recovering from his gunshot wound, but Finch sets him up in an apartment where he’s to keep an eye on the Super, who is their latest POI. Also, Finch approaches Carter and gives her a POI to show her what they do.

episodes.name: Legacy
episodes.overview: When Carter finally comes face-to-face with Reese, he urges her to join forces to help with their latest POI, a scrappy young woman from the wrong side of the tracks who turned her life around and became a lawyer.

episodes.name: Root Cause
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Reese and Finch the number of a down-and-out man who has been pushed too far, and they're forced to turn to former Person of Interest, Zoe Morgan, for help.

episodes.name: Wolf and Cub
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies Darren, a teenager whose brother was just murdered, as the next POI. Meanwhile, Finch is growing concerned that the son of his former business partner is dangerously close to finding out about the Machine.

episodes.name: Blue Code
episodes.overview: Reese discovers there’s more to the story after he infiltrates a smuggling ring to get close to his latest POI.

episodes.name: Risk
episodes.overview: The Machine leads Reese and Finch to Wall Street when a sharp young trader at a major investment bank becomes embroiled in a multi-million dollar financial scam.

episodes.name: Baby Blue
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out the number of a 6-month-old baby, Reese and Finch turn into overly protective parents – with an arsenal at their disposal. Meanwhile, when Elias resurfaces, Detective Carter begins to question her new allegiance with Reese and Finch.

episodes.name: Identity Crisis
episodes.overview: The Machine's latest number presents a unique challenge for Reese and Finch since the person has virtually no digital footprint - and appears to be leading a double life.

episodes.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out five numbers, naming the Don of each of New York’s crime families, Reese and Finch suspect Elias is planning to eliminate his competition.

episodes.name: Matsya Nyaya
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover as an armored car company employee, and faces memories from his past with the CIA.

episodes.name: Many Happy Returns
episodes.overview: Finch gives Reese his birthday off so that his partner doesn't have to face a Number that is tied to Reese's past.

episodes.name: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: The newest POI’s curiosity could spell his doom when he finds himself embroiled in a dark government conspiracy – one that Finch is all too familiar with. Meanwhile, Reese uncovers something revealing about Finch’s past.

episodes.name: Firewall
episodes.overview: As the clock ticks down, Reese winds up trapped with his POI in the most heavily surveilled part of the city, forced to rely on the help of Finch, Carter and Fusco to fend off the FBI, corrupt cops and a slew of old foes.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A supercomputer developed by reclusive billionaire and software genius Harold Finch analyzes data patterns in surveillance for the U.S. government to identify impending acts of terrorism. But the computer, known only as "The Machine", can also identify ordinary people who are about to be involved in violent crimes. Can those crimes be stopped before they take place? Secretly tapping into The Machine, Finch and ex-CIA agent John Reese use vigilante tactics and state-of-the-art technology to identify the soon-to-be victims and prevent the crimes from occuring. Meanwhile, two NYPD detectives Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco are drawn into the cases and the mystery surrounding the two covert crime fighters.

episodes.name: The Contingency
episodes.overview: With Finch missing – kidnapped by his hacker nemesis, Root, Reese enlists Detectives Carter and Fusco to get his friend back, Meanwhile, The Machine never sleeps, disseminating a new number to Reese.

episodes.name: Bad Code
episodes.overview: The Machine delivers the number of a cold case that leads Reese ever closer to catching up with Finch and his kidnapper, Root.

episodes.name: Masquerade
episodes.overview: With Finch back in the Library, Reese returns to field work, only to face his toughest case yet – protecting the privileged daughter of a Brazilian diplomat.

episodes.name: Triggerman
episodes.overview: When The Machine gives them the number of a mob enforcer whose life becomes endangered, Reese and Finch must decide whether to intervene or allow karma to balance the scales of justice. Meanwhile, Finch seeks aid from an unlikely source.

episodes.name: Bury the Lede
episodes.overview: Reese must protect an investigative journalist through surreptitious means to avoid becoming part of her story.

episodes.name: The High Road
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover in an idyllic neighborhood when The Machine’s latest number sends him to the suburbs.

episodes.name: Critical
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Finch and Reese the number of a brilliant surgeon, but they soon discover that a resourceful third party has raised the stakes for this POI, forcing them to turn to an unlikely source for help.

episodes.name: Til Death
episodes.overview: The team is spread thin when a husband and wife’s numbers both come up

episodes.name: C.O.D.
episodes.overview: When the machine names a New York cabdriver as a person of interest, any of his passengers could be a part of the impending crime.

episodes.name: Shadow Box
episodes.overview: As the FBI pursues "the man in the suit," Reese is even more determined to protect the latest person of interest after learning she is the sister of a soldier who was killed in action.

episodes.name: 2πR
episodes.overview: Finch goes under cover to protect a youth who reminds him of himself; Carter goes on a dangerous mission for the FBI.

episodes.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
episodes.overview: Carter tries to help Reese by engaging in mental warfare with the FBI; Reese has encounters with old and new enemies; Detective Fusco must protect supermodel Karolina Kurkova, the latest person of interest.

episodes.name: Dead Reckoning
episodes.overview: Reese is abducted by a former acquaintance planning a massive and potentially deadly act of cyber-warfare.

episodes.name: One Percent
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese meet their match: a tech billionaire whose curiosity and endless resources could expose their identities and ruin their efforts to save his life.

episodes.name: Booked Solid
episodes.overview: As Reese and Finch try to save a hotel maid's life, they encounter a litany of suspects; Detective Carter considers a significant offer from the FBI.

episodes.name: Relevance
episodes.overview: A lethal government operative who tracks and stops terrorist threats before they occur finds herself on the run – and the new focus of Reese and Finch's attention. However, their pursuit proves to be their most formidable when they discover that her remarkable skill set equals their own.

episodes.name: Proteus
episodes.overview: As Finch and Reese try to protect six people simultaneously, clues lead them to a coastal town; when a storm forces Finch and Reese to seek shelter in a police station with a group of locals, they realize a killer may be in their midst.

episodes.name: All In
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese head to Atlantic City to protect the latest person of interest, an elderly gambler; Carter tries to clear another detective's name.

episodes.name: Trojan Horse
episodes.overview: Finch infiltrates a tech corporation to gather intel on an executive whose number has come up; Carter questions Beecher's integrity.

episodes.name: In Extremis
episodes.overview: When a person of interest is poisoned, Finch and Reese only have 24 hours to identify the toxin and find the person responsible; Detective Fusco's past catches up to him.

episodes.name: Zero Day
episodes.overview: When a virus causes the machine to malfunction, numbers are issued irregularly; the team searches for an extremely elusive tech millionaire.

episodes.name: God Mode
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese team up with unexpected allies as they race to fix the machine; as Detective Carter tries to apprehend Cal Beecher's murderer, she finds herself up against HR -- a criminal organization.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Machine identifies another gripping season's worth of potential crimes that must be stopped. Adversaries from Reese's undercover past and Finch's government work threaten the team's crime-fighting mission and anonymity. Meanwhile, Detectives Carter and Fusco face down FBI probes and the dangerous tentacles of the police conspiracy known as "HR".

episodes.name: Liberty
episodes.overview: The Machine, now completely self-governed with its whereabouts unknown, resumes giving Finch its "irrelevant" numbers for people in danger, which include a U.S. naval officer in town for Fleet Week. However, with so many sailors flooding the streets of New York City, finding the officer in time presents an even bigger challenge for Reese and Shaw.

episodes.name: Nothing to Hide
episodes.overview: The number comes up for an Internet entrepreneur in the business of eliminating people's privacy, but finds his own being rapidly stripped away. As his life spirals out of control, Reese tries to protect him while Finch calls on Shaw, Carter and Fusco for help finding whoever is after him.

episodes.name: Lady Killer
episodes.overview: The team suspects the latest number to be a potential stalker/ killer. Root plots her escape from the institution and gives her psychiatrist a big surprise.

episodes.name: Reasonable Doubt
episodes.overview: The team must figure out if a prominent lawyer orchestrated the murder of her husband or if she is being framed; Carter is spotted with Reese by her new partner.

episodes.name: Razgovor
episodes.overview: Shaw must stay close to a 10-year-old girl with highly developed surveillance skills when she is identified by the machine; Carter's mission could be exposed.

episodes.name: Mors Praematura
episodes.overview: After being freed from her confinement to the psych ward, Root needs Shaw's help with a directive from the machine; Finch and Reese look into a mild-mannered investigator.

episodes.name: The Perfect Mark
episodes.overview: The team is met with surprises during an investigation into a hypnotherapist; an antiquities dealer has ties to a crime organization.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.overview: The machine gives Finch 38 numbers at once; information about Carter's past is revealed.

episodes.name: The Crossing
episodes.overview: The battle to bring a crime organization to justice reaches a new level; Reese's number comes up in the machine.

episodes.name: The Devil's Share
episodes.overview: As the POI team seeks justice for Carter’s murder, Finch realizes one of his team members may go one step too far in order to end the war with HR. Also, The Machine gives out the number for NYPD Officer Patrick Simmons, one of the crime organization’s key players.

episodes.name: Lethe
episodes.overview: Flashbacks to Finch’s adolescence provide insight into his creation of The Machine. Also, the team receives the number of an already dying man, and Reese leaves the POI team behind in the aftermath of the war with the crime organization, HR.

episodes.name: Aletheia
episodes.overview: Multiple enemies converge on the POI team as they protect a dying man whose number has come up. They struggle to keep their enemies at bay but without Reese, who has left them and their mission behind following the tragic war with HR, being down one man could have catastrophic repercussions for the team.

episodes.name: 4C
episodes.overview: Reese boards an international flight in an attempt to put the team and the past behind him, but is angered when he realizes his travel plans have been manipulated.

episodes.name: Provenance
episodes.overview: Reese rejoins Finch in New York, but when the team receives the number of a highly skilled antiquities thief, a surprising turn of events finds them planning a heist which could land them all in jail.

episodes.name: Last Call
episodes.overview: Finch goes undercover in an emergency call center to protect a 911 operator, but it soon becomes clear that the threat reaches further than the team could have anticipated.

episodes.name: RAM
episodes.overview: The secrets of Finch’s operation before he enlisted Reese are revealed, including shocking ties to present-day events.
The Machine assigns Root to seek out a janitor with a mysterious past, but when her very presence puts his life in danger, Finch also receives his number.

episodes.name: Allegiance
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese must delve into the murky waters of international politics when they are given the number of a former government contractor who is stalking a UN diplomat. Also, an enemy attempts to gain an upper hand on Root.

episodes.name: Most Likely To...
episodes.overview: Reese and Shaw pose as alumni at a high school reunion in order to keep eyes on the latest POI. Meanwhile, Finch and Fusco travel to Washington, D.C., to investigate the motivations behind Vigilance’s latest attack.

episodes.name: Death Benefit
episodes.overview: Reese poses as a Secret Service agent to get close to the latest POI, a U.S. congressman who may hold the key to derailing Decima’s plans to bring a second Machine online.

episodes.name: Beta
episodes.overview: As Decima uses Samaritan’s feeds to hunt Reese and Shaw, Greer exploits Finch’s greatest weakness in an attempt to lure him out of hiding: his love for his former fiancée, Grace Hendricks.

episodes.name: A House Divided
episodes.overview: When an unknown entity prevents The Machine from seeing the full picture of an impending catastrophic event, it sends the team five separate numbers to help them piece together the bigger picture. Meanwhile, Root’s team of hackers arrives in New York.

episodes.name: Deus Ex Machina
episodes.overview: The team takes desperate action in its race to prevent the malevolent AI program Samaritan from coming online and making them its first targets. Meanwhile, the months-long battle with the anti-surveillance terrorist group Vigilance comes to a shocking conclusion.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The team suffers a devastating loss and confront staggering challenges. Adapting to the next evolution of The Machine, now completely self-governed and hidden from all, Finch and Reese team with rogue agent Sameen Shaw to save lives and seek justice, but their missions now threaten to tear them apart. Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco finally unravel the criminal police conspiracy "HR" - but at a tragic cost. And former cyber-enemy — and now highly tuned confederate of The Machine — Root becomes an unpredictable ally when the team learns a second surveillance apparatus to rival The Machine is on the verge of activation.

episodes.name: Panopticon
episodes.overview: Forced to take on new identities provided by Root, the team members try to adapt to their new lives. However, some find it hard to ignore The Machine's numbers, which puts them all at risk of being detected by Samaritan.

episodes.name: Nautilus
episodes.overview: Despite not wanting to help with the new numbers, Finch's interest is piqued when the newest person of interest turns out to be a brilliant college student involved with a mysterious scavenger hunt.

episodes.name: Wingman
episodes.overview: Finch recruits Fusco to stick close to the latest POI, a professional 'wingman', but learning how to approach women soon becomes the least of his worries. Reese must find a way to play by the rules at his new day job. The Machine sends Finch and Root on a mysterious errand.

episodes.name: Brotherhood
episodes.overview: Reese's cover job as a detective at the NYPD becomes complicated when the young brother and sister he's protecting become targets of a gang investigation.

episodes.name: Prophets
episodes.overview: While Reese is forced to go to counseling for his violent tendencies, Root, Shaw and Finch try to help a new POI.

episodes.name: Pretenders
episodes.overview: Reese, Shaw and Fusco must protect a unassuming office worker who stumbles into a dangerous conspiracy while moonlighting as fake detective. Finch travels to Hong Kong as part of his academic cover identity.

episodes.name: Honor Among Thieves
episodes.overview: Shaw joins a team of international thieves in order to keep tabs on the latest POI, but an unexpected turn of events puts her in danger of being detected by Samaritan.  Also, Finch and Root undertake a dangerous sabotage mission.

episodes.name: Point of Origin
episodes.overview: Reese volunteers as an NYPD police academy instructor in order to keep an eye on a talented young officer whose suspicious actions make him question her motives. Meanwhile, Martine – armed with information from Samaritan – hunts a member of the team.

episodes.name: The Devil You Know
episodes.overview: Reese must save Elias from the Brotherhood. He can't get any help from Root or Shaw since Shaw's cover is blown and Root is escorting her to underground.

episodes.name: The Cold War
episodes.overview: Samaritan shows its power by erasing crime from the city for a day in an attempt to force The Machine out of hiding.

episodes.name: If-Then-Else
episodes.overview: Samaritan launches a cyber-attack on the stock exchange, forcing the team to risk their lives in a desperate mission to stop a global economic catastrophe.

episodes.name: Control-Alt-Delete
episodes.overview: Control, who oversees the handling of relevant numbers for the government, begins to question the methods and intentions of the Samaritan program. Also, alarming news reports of a pair of vigilantes rampaging through the Northeast begin to surface.

episodes.name: M.I.A.
episodes.overview: Root and Reese investigate a small town in upstate New York that holds the key to Shaw's location... and whether she's dead or alive.

episodes.name: Guilty
episodes.overview: When the Machine arranges for Finch to sit on the jury of a murder trial, he begins to suspect that a fellow juror is set to rig the proceedings. Meanwhile, Reese begins to open up to the department’s therapist.

episodes.name: Q&A
episodes.overview: Reese tries to protect a software programmer with a mysterious second life, but it’s unclear which side of her life the threat is coming from. Meanwhile, Claire, a young hacker whom Finch tried to protect from Samaritan, reaches out to him for aid.

episodes.name: Blunt
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch must protect Harper, a street-smart grifter, when her plan to steal cash from a medical marijuana dispensary goes up in smoke.

episodes.name: Karma
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch try to protect a psychologist whose unorthodox methods for helping his patients find closure could cost him dearly. Meanwhile, flashbacks reveal Finch’s fragile state in the days following the bombing that killed his best friend, Nathan Ingram.

episodes.name: Skip
episodes.overview: Reese must protect a bounty hunter who refuses to allow the potential threat to her life sway her from the relentless pursuit of her target. Also, Finch tries to set the plan he began in Shanghai in motion.

episodes.name: Search and Destroy
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch scramble to protect a software CEO when his behavior becomes increasingly erratic following a hacker attack that reveals all his secrets and unravels his life.

episodes.name: Terra Incognita
episodes.overview: Reese finds himself on a dangerous personal journey when he takes on a homicide case Detective Carter was never able to close.

episodes.name: Asylum
episodes.overview: Reese and Fusco get caught in the war between the two newest POIs, rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic. Also, a tantalizing clue to Shaw’s whereabouts leads Finch and Root into a possible trap, and Control goes rogue to uncover the true intentions of the Samaritan program.

episodes.name: YHWH
episodes.overview: Finch and Root race to save The Machine, which has been located by the rival AI, Samaritan. Also, Reese is caught in the middle of the final showdown between rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Although they’ve saved countless lives thanks to The Machine’s omniscience, John Reese and Harold Finch, along with lethal operative Sameen Shaw and unpredictable cyber-hacker Root now face an uncertain future. With a second machine — Samaritan — now online, the elusive team are now targets themselves, hiding in plain sight. The only thing more frightening than the ruthless Decima organization calling the shots is leaving those decisions up to an untested Machine. Facing a dangerous tomorrow, the POI team must find a way to outsmart Samaritan, an all-seeing, all-powerful artificial intelligence that’s self-governing, continually evolving and growing stronger every day.

episodes.name: B.S.O.D.
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch attempt to rescue the Machine’s source code before it deteriorates beyond repair. Also, Root fights for her life against an onslaught of Samaritan’s agents and Fusco is faced with hard questions following the deaths of Dominic and Elias.

episodes.name: SNAFU
episodes.overview: The Machine experiences a glitch during rebooting, supplying Reese and Fusco with the numbers of dozens of people not actually involved in crimes, while also locking Finch and Root out after identifying them as threats based on past violent behavior.

episodes.name: Truth Be Told
episodes.overview: Reese’s cover could be blown when he realizes the latest POI has ties to his old CIA colleague, Kara Stanton.
Shaw escapes her captors, but the team is unsure of her mental state when she begins to act paranoid and reckless.

episodes.name: ShotSeeker
episodes.overview: Reese protects an NYPD analyst whose investigation into a software glitch has drawn the attention of Samaritan. Also, Reese and Fusco are threatened by an ally of Elias’s, who is looking to avenge his friend’s death.

episodes.name: A More Perfect Union
episodes.overview: The Machine sends Reese and Finch to a wedding to protect a pair of POIs before their nuptials. Also, Fusco becomes angry at being kept in the dark by the team and takes it upon himself to investigate a string of missing person reports.

episodes.name: QSO
episodes.overview: Root goes undercover at a radio station to protect the host of a conspiracy theory show who stumbles upon information that could get him killed. Also, Samaritan’s agents try to convince a member of the team that their goals are noble.

episodes.name: Reassortment
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch become trapped in a hospital that becomes ground zero for a deadly viral outbreak. Also, Samaritan’s newest recruit has second thoughts and Shaw continues to struggle with reality.

episodes.name: Sotto Voce
episodes.overview: The mysterious criminal mastermind known as “The Voice” returns and traps Reese and Fusco in their own precinct with several armed gang members and the latest POI. Also, Root makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: The Day the World Went Away
episodes.overview: Finch’s number comes up when a fatal error blows his cover identity and sets off a deadly series of escalating encounters with Samaritan’s operatives.

episodes.name: Synecdoche
episodes.overview: The team must unravel a conspiracy and stay ahead of the Secret Service when the President of the United States becomes their newest POI. Also, Finch separates himself from the team and considers taking drastic action to combat Samaritan.

episodes.name: .exe
episodes.overview: As Reese and Shaw race to catch up with Finch, he infiltrates a maximum-security government facility in a desperate mission which could mean the end for not only Samaritan, but for himself and The Machine as well.

episodes.name: return 0
episodes.overview: Finch, Reese, Fusco and Shaw embark on one last mission to prevent Samaritan from destroying The Machine and cementing its hold over mankind.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: For years, the Person of Interest team have been protected by The Machine, but as worlds collided and a rival AI known as Samaritan finally cornered The Machine inside the nation’s power grid, it was the POI team’s turn to protect Finch’s creation. In season five, the cold war is over. The world around us might look the same, but something has drastically changed. Samaritan’s lethal “correction” has initiated its control. Finch’s Machine is essentially dead. Shaw is still missing. And the team is once again hiding in plain sight. But with Samaritan’s invisible grip tightening everywhere, will Finch be able to rebuild and resurrect The Machine? And if he does, will it be the same Machine when it comes back online?

episodes.name: Grenade
episodes.overview: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.

episodes.overview: Carol tests the boundaries of this weirdly honest world at the expense of her ego. Far away, a resolute individual learns he's not alone.

episodes.overview: Carol doubles down on her investigation—loneliness be damned. Meanwhile, howls in the night reveal a new source of danger.

episodes.overview: Carol shares a horrific discovery and learns new truths in the process. Mr. Diabaté lives life to the fullest in Sin City.

episodes.overview: Carol takes a different tack with The Others and discovers more than she anticipated. Manousos awakens in unfamiliar surroundings.

episodes.overview: They’re back - bolder, louder, and ready to slay all over again! Ten Drag Race glamazons compete for the coveted title of Queen of the Mothertucking World.

episodes.name: Global Glamazons
episodes.overview: In this opening episode, head judge RuPaul introduces the global glamazons to each other for the first time and sets them their first challenge - to stage their very own royal command performance. With their future in the competition already on the line, each queen is keen to impress as they perform in a talent show fit for a queen.

episodes.name: RuPaul Ball
episodes.overview: The fierce international Drag Race competition continues, and this week it’s the RuPaul Ball! In a celebration of all things RuPaul, the queens must serve three looks on the runway, including an outfit they must create from scratch that Mama Ru herself would want to wear.

episodes.name: West End Wendys
episodes.overview: The fierce international competition to be crowned Queen of the Mothertucking World continues.Seven global glamazons remain, and this week the pressure amplifies, as their stage presence and their singing and dancing skills are seriously tested in a celebration of musical theatre. The queens are performing West End Wendys - The Rusical.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The fierce international competition to be crowned Queen of the Mothertucking World continues, and this week it’s the legendary Drag Race challenge: the Snatch Game... but with a twist! With iconic team captains Katie Price and Michelle Visage at the helm, the queens showcase their best celebrity impressions and improv skills in an attempt to make Mama Ru laugh.

episodes.name: Semifinals
episodes.overview: The fierce international competition to crown the Queen of the Mothertucking World reaches the nail-biting semi-finals! This week, the queens are tasked with an all-singing, all-dancing challenge: performing their own version of one of RuPaul’s classic hits. Little Mix star Jade Thirlwall coaches the queens as they record their vocals before joining RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the fate of yet another queen is decided

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: It’s the Grand Finale! The UK hosted as nine legendary Drag Race queens from around the world entered the workroom to compete for the title of Queen of the Mothertucking World. Now, six weeks later, RuPaul is about to crown his winner. Which queen will be elevated to true legendary status and do their country proud?

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Legendary queens from RuPaul’s Drag Race franchises around the globe come together in the UK to compete for the title of Queen of the Mothertucking World. Nine iconic drag performers face weekly challenges testing their charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent — from runway glamour to performance and comedy — culminating in lip-sync battles and drag theatrics to determine who will be crowned the first UK vs The World champion.

episodes.name: The Queens' Variety Show
episodes.overview: The famous race steps up to Olympian level as elite Drag Race queens from around the world take on the UK in a bid to be Mama Ru's favourite. Richard E. Grant joins in the fun.

episodes.name: The Happy Ending Ball
episodes.overview: The Olympics of drag continues as supermodel Adwoa Aboah joins RuPaul as guest judge, and the queens race against the clock to create a fairy-tale outfit suitable for a princess.

episodes.name: Drag Race World
episodes.overview: The queens attempt to make Mama Ru laugh as they create adverts for their own Drag Race-themed immersive experiences. Grammy-winning pop star Kim Petras joins the judging panel.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Jane McDonald and Sinitta join the queens as they tackle the iconic Snatch Game challenge whilst Olympic gold medallist and longtime Drag Race stan Tom Daley guest judges.

episodes.name: Seven!: The Rusical

episodes.name: Strictly Come Prancing
episodes.overview: Strictly legends Motsi Mabuse, Janette Manrara and Aljaž Škorjanec guest star as the queens take on a high level, high stakes dance-off with a twist in Strictly Come Prancing.

episodes.name: The Haters Wedding Roast
episodes.overview: It's the semi-finals! And The queens’ stand-up skills are tested as they battle for a place in the grand finale in a wedding themed roast. Comedian Katherine Ryan guest judges.

episodes.name: Grand Finale

seasons.name: Series 2

This international all-stars competition sees eleven queens compete in weekly performance, fashion and acting challenges for the title of Queen of the Mothertucking World — and, for the first time in the UK vs The World format, a cash prize of £50,000. Expect unforgettable runway looks, outrageous werkroom drama and jaw-dropping lip-sync battles as the contenders sashay for the crown.

episodes.name: RuRuvision Song Contest
episodes.overview: The international spin-off of Drag Race UK returns as the queens take on the Ruruvision Song Contest. Loreen joins the judging panel.

episodes.name: Runway Ru-Mix
episodes.overview: The Olympics of drag continues as the Queens' design skills in a Runway Ru‐Mix. Supermodel and Drag Race fan favorite Kristen McMenamy guest judges.

episodes.name: The Miss Snatch Game Pageant
episodes.overview: The Snatch Game is back - but with a twist - in the all new Miss Snatch Game Pageant. Pussycat Dolls Kimberly Wyatt and Ashley Roberts and pop superstar Jade join in the fun.

episodes.name: Girl Groups From Outer Space
episodes.overview: The queens go inter-gay-lactic as they tackle a space themed Girl Group challenge. Rag’n’Bone Man and Bananarama join in the fun.

episodes.name: Silent Movie Acting Challenge
episodes.overview: Russell T Davies directs the queens as they star in silent movie shorts. Will Poulter joins RuPaul, Michelle Visage, and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Fringe Festival
episodes.overview: Jayde Adams is on hand to help the queens as they take to the stage in comedy double acts. Amandaland star Lucy Punch joins RuPaul on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Olympian Makeovers
episodes.overview: The queens give drag makeovers to Team GB Olympians Greg Rutherford, Shanaze Reade, Molly Thompson-Smith, Celia Quansah and Daniel Jervis. Pop superstar Anastacia guest judges.

In this global drag showdown, legendary queens from across the Drag Race franchise come together in the UK to compete for the coveted title of Queen of the Mothertucking World. Expect charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent as the competing queens sash-away the competition in a battle of drag excellence on the world stage.

episodes.name: Monopulence!
episodes.overview: Tensions still run high in the aftermath of the Monopulence design challenge. The bottom queens are emotional after critiques, and one queen rubs her sisters the wrong way. Queer icon, Sandra Bernhard shares the lessons she’s learned during her amazing career.

episodes.name: Bitch, I'm a Drag Queen!

Everyone is gagged when a confident queen finally loses her cool. There are tears and anger in the lounge as the queens realize the game is heating up and no one is really safe.

episodes.name: RDR Live!
episodes.overview: Drag delusion settles into the Untucked Lounge. Feeling salty about landing in the bottom, one Queen calls out her sisters. A funny runway divides the room and everyone is bothered. Paul W. Downs gets the Queens out of their heads with some good advice.

episodes.overview: It's sink or swim after the Sea Sickening Ball. One Queen is shook after her confidence is put to the test. Guest Judge and trans trailblazer Hunter Schafer visits the lounge and gets her flowers from the Queens.

episodes.overview: After the Snatch Game critiques, a safe placement has left one Queen a little salty. A Queen with a strong track record lands in the bottom. Guest Judge Quinta Brunson uplifts the Queens.

episodes.overview: The safe Queens are feeling playful and decide to mess with the rest of the girls. One Queen questions the difficulty of her sister's role in the Rusical. Guest judge Adam Lambert thrills the Queens by stopping by and sharing his journey.

episodes.overview: The Queens are campaigning hard for a particular bottom Queen to be sent home. The critiqued Queens interrupt a chaotic moment in the lounge. Guest judge Betsey Johnson stops by and gets the Queens out of their heads and on their feet.

episodes.name: The Villains Roast
episodes.overview: Unresolved tension from this week's challenge comes to a head in the Untucked lounge; Two friends are torn apart, and two friends strengthen their bond; One Queen makes an enemy after standing up for her sister.

episodes.name: Ross Mathews vs. The Ducks
episodes.overview: Harsh realities are sinking in after the Queens reveal their picks to go home. Two Queens feel defeated after finding themselves in the bottom. Guest judge Sam Smith shares his favorite way to wind down after a long day.

episodes.name: Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve & Talent Monologues
episodes.overview: The spirit of delusion is alive and well in the Untucked lounge. One Queen does not understand why she is not in the top this week. While another Queen pins her hopes of staying on a long shot.

episodes.name: Drag Baby Mamas
episodes.overview: The Queens and their parents celebrate the completion of an emotionally charged makeover challenge. After the parents leave, the mood in the lounge quickly turns bittersweet. The finale is fast approaching and not everyone is going to make it to the end.

episodes.name: How's Your Headliner?
episodes.overview: The top Queens enter the Untucked lounge for the final time. Their fates are uncertain, but they all agree that they have had the time of their lives. Guest judge, Tracee Ellis Ross stops by to thank the Queens for putting on an amazing show.

episodes.overview: While acclimating to purgatory at Split River High, Maddie becomes determined to solve the mystery of her disappearance. While observing those she left behind, Maddie begins to realize everyone is not as honest and loyal as she once thought.

episodes.overview: As Homecoming unfolds at Split River, Maddie finds herself divided between accepting her fate in purgatory and a newly hatched plan to crack a new suspect.

episodes.name: Grave the Last Dance
episodes.overview: Amongst the sparkly lights of Split River's Homecoming Dance, Operation Find Maddie's Killer goes into overdrive leading to surprising revelations.

episodes.name: Séance Anything
episodes.overview: The spirits enlist Dawn to help Maddie recall her last living moments which takes a heartbreaking turn. Nicole desperately tries to keep a secret from being revealed. As the spirits begin to ask more questions, an unexpected turn of events takes place within their own.

episodes.overview: Questioning their existence, the spirits seek Mr. Martin for answers. Maddie must confront the latest suspect which challenges everything she thought she knew before. Xavier, Claire and Nicole look for answers at an abandoned house. When the truth is finally revealed, Maddie must face unexpected and devastating consequences.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Maddie, a teen stuck in the afterlife, investigates her own mysterious disappearance alongside a group of other students who are also stuck in limbo at their high school. Maddie goes on a crime-solving journey as she adjusts to high-school purgatory, but the closer she gets to discovering the truth, the more secrets and lies she uncovers.

episodes.name: Whatever Happened to Maddie Nears?
episodes.overview: Maddie confronts Mr. Martin, who flees. Janet, in Maddie's body, returns to her family's now dilapidated farmhouse, triggering memories. A conflicted Simon struggles with his desire to help Maddie and protect his own grasp on reality.

episodes.name: Field of Screams
episodes.overview: Fugitive Janet is haunted by her past as the ghost group continues searching for Mr. Martin inside Split River High. Simon tells the living kids about Janet's body-snatching. A fire at a dilapidated farmhouse leaves Maddie's fate unclear. We are introduced to two additional ghosts at Split River High.

episodes.overview: A relentless Sandra is desperate to know her daughters fate, as Janet in Maddie's body wreaks havoc in the living world. Simon and friends search for Janet/Maddie in an unlikely place, as the ghosts decode Janet's past.

episodes.name: A Walk-In to Remember
episodes.overview: Janet/Maddie returns home to a shocked and relieved Sandra. The ghosts discover the objects from their deaths unlock hidden spaces. A mandatory school event uncovers tension between the living kids who are more concerned about Janet's return.

episodes.overview: Janet/Maddie agrees to have Maddie's friends over for dinner and the tense meal ends with Janet realizing her cover is blown. Meanwhile, Maddie explores the school's "scars" and uncovers intel about Janet that shakes her resolve.

episodes.name: Ghost Pointe Blank
episodes.overview: Maddie and the ghosts find a link between their scars while Simon and team go on a mission where tensions rise with the arrival of an unexpected visitor.

episodes.name: Anatomy of a Fallout Shelter
episodes.overview: Janet is finally ready to give answers. Mr. Martin hatches a plan, Maddie reevaluates her relationships with Wally and Simon, and Quinn makes a discovery.

episodes.name: Fire, Talk to Me
episodes.overview: Maddie and the ghosts confront Mr. Martin, ultimately trapping him in the afterlife; new information leads to a chase through the school's scars, delaying Maddie's return to the living world and putting her body in jeopardy.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Picking up from the shocking season one finale, Maddie works to bring a doubting Simon—her only connection to the living world—back on board to help her track down and collect her missing body. Stuck in the afterlife with the knowledge of what happened to her, Maddie must unite her friends in the spectral and living worlds in order to reclaim her stolen life.

episodes.overview: Split River High grows volatile as Maddie faces mounting pressure; buried truths and new dangers are revealed that could change everything for the living and the dead, forcing some to question who they can trust.

episodes.name: The Halls Have Eyes
episodes.overview: New mysteries at Split River High force Maddie, Simon and the ghosts to choose between leaving the past alone or exploring it and triggering unseen dangers; as Nicole joins a new circle, Simon and Wally take a risky leap for answers.

episodes.overview: A detention day unearths Split River's buried secrets and hidden history.

episodes.overview: Investigation into the high school's "scars" deepens as the search for answers regarding Simon continues. New discoveries threaten the ghosts as Maddie and Simon fight to stay ahead.

episodes.overview: Maddie faces a powerful new threat as Simon slips further into danger.

episodes.overview: After a shocking event, Maddie and Xavier come under suspicion. As the living investigate a corrupt scheme, the ghosts search their scars for clues, Maddie opens up, and someone takes a big leap that could change everything.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 1795, three teenage boys discovered a strange, man-made depression in the ground on Oak Island–a small, wooded island just off the coast of Nova Scotia, Canada. As the boys began to dig, they found a number of intriguing artifacts. It was the end of the piracy era and rumors of buried treasure were rampant. The boys’ discovery launched a treasure hunt that has spanned more than 200 years.The search had gone dormant, but last year, Rick and Marty Lagina, two brothers from Michigan with a life-long interest in the mystery, renewed the efforts to discover the legendary treasure.
