episodes.name: Dulcinea
episodes.overview: In the outer solar system near Saturn, James Holden and the crew of the ice-freighter Canterbury, investigate a distress call from a mysterious derelict ship, the Scopuli. On Ceres Station, Detective Miller begins an off the book investigation of a missing heiress, Julie Mao.

episodes.name: The Big Empty
episodes.overview: Holden and crew are trapped in badly damaged shuttle. On Ceres, Miller uncovers clues about Julie Mao. On Earth, Chrisjen Avasarala questions a terrorist.

episodes.name: Remember the Cant
episodes.overview: Holden and the crew are taken prisoner by the Martian Congressional Republic Navy. Miller deals with unhappy rioters. Avasarala plays politics and gets severely burned.

episodes.name: CQB
episodes.overview: Holden and crew find themselves in the middle of a desperate battle while still aboard the Martian battleship. Miller’s partner, Havelock, goes missing.

episodes.name: Back to the Butcher
episodes.overview: Holden finds an unlikely ally. Miller’s obsession with Mao intensifies.

episodes.name: Rock Bottom
episodes.overview: Miller gains valuable information from a hidden data cube. Holden and his crew learn their host’s agenda.

episodes.name: Windmills
episodes.overview: Holden and his crew face a Martian military blockade. Miller finds a new reason to forge ahead. Avasarala visits Holden’s family.

episodes.name: Salvage
episodes.overview: A derelict vessel holds a potentially devastating secret. Holden and his crew cross paths with Miller on Eros. Avasarala receives bad news.

episodes.name: Critical Mass
episodes.overview: Julie's origin story ends up revealing her trajectory. Holden and Miller work together as they take a look at a strange emergency happening on Eros.

episodes.name: Leviathan Wakes
episodes.overview: Avasarala uncovers a game-changing secret while the future of the human race might be in Holden and Miller's hands.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In season one, the disappearance of rich-girl-turned-political-activist Julie Mao linked the lives of Ceres' detective Joe Miller, accidental ship captain James Holden and U.N. politician Chrisjen Avasarala. Amidst political tension between Earth, Mars and the Asteroid Belt, these three individuals unravel the single greatest conspiracy of all time.

episodes.name: Safe
episodes.overview: Unlikely allies Joe Miller and the crew of the Rocinante led by Jim Holden uncover more about the conspiracy to release the protomolecule on Eros station.

episodes.name: Doors & Corners
episodes.overview: With the help of Fred Johnson and the OPA, Miller, Holden and the crew stage a raid for information on the protomolecule. On Earth, Avasarala learns a truth about Fred Johnson.

episodes.name: Static
episodes.overview: Holden and Miller butt heads about how the raid was handled.

episodes.name: Godspeed
episodes.overview: Miller devises a dangerous plan to eradicate what's left of the protomolecule on Eros.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: The Rocinante chases an asteroid as it hurtles towards Earth.

episodes.name: Paradigm Shift
episodes.overview: Earth and Mars search for answers in the aftermath of the asteroid collision.

episodes.name: The Seventh Man
episodes.overview: Preparations for the Earth/Mars peace conference tighten the tension on Erringwright.

episodes.name: Pyre
episodes.overview: Naomi tracks down signs of the protomolecule; Fred Johnson's control over the OPA collapses.

episodes.name: The Weeping Somnambulist
episodes.overview: Bobbie becomes a political pawn in the struggle between Earth and Mars.

episodes.name: Cascade
episodes.overview: Holden leads his crew through the war-torn station on Ganymede.

episodes.name: Here There Be Dragons
episodes.overview: Bobbie makes a decision that changes her life forever.

episodes.name: The Monster and the Rocket
episodes.overview: A discovery pushes Naomi and Holden apart and sets the Rocinante crew against each other.

episodes.name: Caliban's War
episodes.overview: The Rocinante crew must fight to save the ship.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 kicks off with interplanetary tensions at an all-time high, the cold war between Earth and Mars is on the brink of an all-out battle.

episodes.name: Fight or Flight
episodes.overview: The Rocinante crew deals with the fallout over Naomi's betrayal while caught in the middle of the war between Earth and Mars. Meanwhile, Avasarala and Bobbie hatch an escape plan.

episodes.name: IFF
episodes.overview: The Rocinante answers an unexpected distress signal. Bobbie and Avasarala find themselves being hunted by a mysterious captor. UN Secretary-General Sorrento-Gillis brings in a colleague from his past to lend an ear during this crucial time of war.

episodes.name: Assured Destruction
episodes.overview: As Earth strategizes a costly ploy to gain advantage in the war against Mars, Anna struggles to convince Sorrento-Gillis to do the right thing. Avasarala and Bobbie seek refuge aboard the Rocinante.

episodes.name: Reload
episodes.overview: The Rocinante tends to wounded Martian soldiers in exchange for supplies. Avasarala struggles with how to disseminate a key piece of evidence despite being in hiding.

episodes.name: Triple Point
episodes.overview: The search for Prax's daughter comes to a head. Admiral Souther's men plan for mutiny aboard the Agatha King

episodes.name: Immolation
episodes.overview: The final battle between Earth and Mars threatens the very future of humanity. A new monster is unleashed on Prospero Station. Anna receives the smoking gun she needs.

episodes.name: Delta-V
episodes.overview: All eyes turn to the edge of the solar system as a mysterious new presence emerges; Naomi recommits to her roots; Drummer butts heads with a seasoned new commander aboard the Behemoth; and a young Belter makes a name for himself.

episodes.name: It Reaches Out
episodes.overview: An old friend taunts Holden with the answers he seeks. Naomi struggles to fit in. A mysterious low-level tech aboard the Thomas Prince enacts a terrifying plan.

episodes.name: Intransigence
episodes.overview: The Rocinante seeks a new gameplan as they attempt to avoid capture. Melba's true motives are revealed. Naomi is torn between identity and ideal. Anna seeks a way to stay aboard the Thomas Prince.

episodes.name: Dandelion Sky
episodes.overview: Holden sees past, present, and future. A ghost from Melba's past threatens her mission. Bobbie struggles to trust an old friend as she leads a group into unchartered territory.

episodes.name: Fallen World
episodes.overview: Drummer and Ashford find themselves trapped with few options for survival; Anna tends to the wounded masses as Melba continues to hunt down her prey; the Rocinante crew struggles to survive as Naomi reunites with her true family.

episodes.name: Congregation
episodes.overview: As survivors arrive at the Behemoth, two factions form over how to handle a life-or-death threat. Holden grapples with what he's seen and the choices he must make.

episodes.name: Abaddon's Gate
episodes.overview: Holden and his allies must stop Ashford and his team from destroying the Ring, and perhaps all of humanity.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: As the Rocinante crew digs deeper into the search for Prax's missing daughter, the war between Earth and Mars turns deadly in ways the solar system has never seen. But a new threat in the outer reaches of the Belt could prove much more dangerous, threatening to test the very future of humanity.

episodes.name: New Terra
episodes.overview: The crew of the Roci investigates a strange protomolecule ruin on an alien planet. Bobbie copes with civilian life on Mars. Drummer and Ashford battle with piracy in the Belt.

episodes.name: Jetsam
episodes.overview: Avasarala is blindsided while on a visit to Mars. The Roci crew continue their protomolecule investigation while tensions between the RCE and Belters reach a tipping point. Drummer and Ashford track down a terrorist.

episodes.name: Subduction
episodes.overview: New alien threats emerge on Ilus as Naomi battles health challenges on the planet. Bobbie searches for a missing person on Mars. Avasarala faces a new challenge in the UN.

episodes.name: Retrograde
episodes.overview: Drummer and Ashford confront a dangerous person from Naomi's past. Murtry hunts down a target. Bobbie's makes a life-changing confession.

episodes.name: Oppressor
episodes.overview: As tensions on Ilus reach a boiling point, Holden reveals a secret. Avasarala debates Nancy Gao while an emergency on the Roci forces Alex and Naomi into action.

episodes.name: Displacement
episodes.overview: The Roci crew prepares for an incoming disaster on Ilus. Ashford and Drummer close in on an enemy within the Belt. Bobbie takes on a dangerous job.

episodes.name: A Shot in the Dark
episodes.overview: Naomi and Alex work to keep the Barbapiccola in orbit amidst a power outage. Avasarala faces a tough decision. Holden and Elvi race to find a cure for a disease spreading on Ilus.

episodes.name: The One-Eyed Man
episodes.overview: Avasarala faces fallout for the UN's military mission. Ashford and Drummer makes big decisions about their future within the OPA. A spreading illness on Ilus takes a toll on Amos. Alex and Naomi's attempt to rescue the Barb turns desperate.

episodes.name: Saeculum
episodes.overview: Holden and Miller race to save Ilus. Murtry puts his endgame into motion, putting the Roci crew's lives at risk.

episodes.name: Cibola Burn
episodes.overview: Ashford closes in on an enemy while uncovering a dangerous plot. Avasarala faces a crossroads in her personal and political life. The Roci crew works to reestablish life on Ilus in the wake of a deadly catastrophe.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: With the Ring Gates now open to thousands of new planets, a blood-soaked gold rush begins, igniting new conflicts between Earth, Mars, and the Belt. Meanwhile, on one unexplored planet, the Rocinante crew gets caught in a violent clash between an Earth mining corporation and desperate Belter settlers as deadly, new threats from the protomolecule emerge.

episodes.name: Exodus
episodes.overview: Holden tries to convince Fred Johnson to destroy the last sample of protomolecule. Naomi gets an important lead to her son. On Luna, Avasarala begins to hunt for Marco Inaros.

episodes.name: Churn
episodes.overview: Holden and Fred deal with infiltrators on Tycho. Drummer's past comes back to haunt her. Amos returns to Baltimore. Alex and Bobbie's investigation on Mars leads to rogue soldiers.

episodes.name: Mother
episodes.overview: Naomi comes face to face with Filip. Holden and Fred turn the tables. Avasarala closes in on Marco's plot.

episodes.name: Gaugamela
episodes.overview: Marco's grand plan shocks Earth, Mars and the Belt.

episodes.name: Down and Out
episodes.overview: Amos and Clarissa are trapped in a collapsed building. Naomi contends with her old family. Holden assembles a new crew on the Roci. Alex and Bobbie make a dangerous discovery in the Belt.

episodes.name: Tribes
episodes.overview: Holden and the Roci go on the hunt. Amos and Clarissa seek shelter on a devastated Earth. Bobbie and Alex fight a desperate battle. Marco makes Drummer an offer she can't refuse. Avasarala returns to a position of power.

episodes.name: Oyedeng
episodes.overview: Naomi makes a desperate attempt to save her son from Marco. On the Roci, Holden battles for the last sample of protomolecule.

episodes.name: Hard Vacuum
episodes.overview: Amos returns to Baltimore with Clarissa. On Luna, Avasarala's alliances begin to shift. Alone and adrift, Naomi becomes a deadly lure.

episodes.name: Winnipesaukee
episodes.overview: Amos, Clarissa, and a gang of thieves work together to leave Earth. Avasarala tries to head off a brutal military strike. Drummer's new family bonds are tested as Naomi's life hangs in the balance.

episodes.name: Nemesis Games
episodes.overview: Holden and the Roci face off against Marco's forces and Drummer, while Alex and Bobbie attempt a dangerous rescue of Naomi, and the balance of power in the Solar System shifts.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In different parts of the Solar System, the crew of the Rocinante and their allies confront the sins of their past, while Marco Inaros unleashes an attack that will alter the future of Earth, Mars, the Belt, and the worlds beyond the Ring.

episodes.name: Strange Dogs
episodes.overview: The Rocinante crew make a startling discovery on an asteroid. Avasarala and Bobbie contend with the devastation on Earth. Drummer and her family must make a heartbreaking decision. On Ceres, Marco and Filip's struggles turn inward.

episodes.name: Azure Dragon
episodes.overview: With an unexpected passenger aboard the Rocinante, Holden and crew undertake a dangerous mission that could shift the balance of power in the war. Drummer decides to make an uneasy alliance. Filip wrestles with his guilt.

episodes.name: Force Projection
episodes.overview: Avasarala, with the Combined Fleet of Earth and Mars, takes the war to Marco. Filip and Marco's relationship is tested. The war becomes more perilous and personal for Holden and Naomi when the Rocinante is suddenly forced into a battle.

episodes.name: Redoubt
episodes.overview: Holden finds himself at odds with his crew when a controversial decision is uncovered. On Ceres, Avasarala struggles to contain an escalating humanitarian crisis. Drummer's growing faction stage a daring raid with dire stakes. Filip, demoted to repair skiff duty, makes an unexpected discovery.

episodes.name: Why We Fight
episodes.overview: Paths converge on Ceres when Drummer and her fleet arrive to aid the relief effort. Holden tries to convince Avasarala to release crucial information that might avert catastrophe, but she has her own request of him. As Amos and Bobbie get a little R&R at the station, Naomi has a difficult and long-awaited reunion.

episodes.name: Babylon's Ashes
episodes.overview: In the thrilling season finale, Inners and Belters fight side by side with the crew of the Rocinante in a last, massive, desperate battle with Marco and his Free Navy, with the fate of the Solar System, the Ring Gates, and of all humanity hanging in the balance.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Holden and the crew of the Rocinante fight alongside the Combined Fleet of Earth and Mars to protect the Inner Planets from Marco Inaros and his Free Navy's campaign of death and destruction. Meanwhile, on a distant planet beyond the Rings, a new power rises.

shows.title: The Expanse

last_episode_to_air.name: Sidney Fairfax
last_episode_to_air.overview: The team pursues Dr. Sidney Fairfax, a twisted neuroscientist who mutilates the brains of his victims. As the case unfolds, Bex realizes the doctor may have not only the key to larger mysteries surrounding the Pit, but insight into Shane's past.

shows.name: The Hunting Party

next_episode_to_air.name: Elliot Carr
next_episode_to_air.overview: Bex and the team hurry to catch Elliot Carr, a high-end shoemaker and serial killer known as the Connecticut Cobbler. Elliot has a fresh approach that the team must figure out before more people find themselves flayed.

shows.overview: A small team of investigators are assembled to track down and capture the most dangerous killers our country has ever seen, all of whom have just escaped from a top-secret prison that's not supposed to exist.

episodes.name: Richard Harris (Pilot)
episodes.overview: When a massive explosion at a top-secret prison known as the Pit allows notorious serial killer Richard Harris to escape, disgraced FBI agent Bex Henderson is called back into action to hunt him down before he kills again.

episodes.name: Clayton Jessup
episodes.overview: Clayton Jessup, a deranged serial killer who targets happy families, is on the loose and looking to kill again. The team must race against time to stop him before it's too late. Bex learns who she can and can't trust.

episodes.name: Lowe
episodes.overview: In rural Montana, the team hunts down Lowe, a brutal serial killer obsessed with wolves. Bex and the team must track Lowe through the wilderness while dealing with local Rangers.

episodes.name: Doctor Ezekiel Malak
episodes.overview: Dr. Ezekiel Malak, a hospital psychiatrist turned serial killer, is prowling for new victims in Chicago. Bex and the team work to find a method to his madness in a desperate bid to get ahead of him until Malak makes a move no one saw coming.

episodes.name: Roy Barber
episodes.overview: When Bex and the team race to stop Roy Barber, known as the Couples Killer, before he strikes again, they uncover a chilling scheme that puts Roy's crimes in an entirely new light.

episodes.name: Arlo Brandt
episodes.overview: Arlo Brandt, a hoarder-turned-serial killer, emerges from the Pit with newly found purpose. As Arlo hunts for innocent victims, Bex and the team must get inside a deranged mind.

episodes.name: Mark Marsden
episodes.overview: Bex and the team race to catch Mark Marsden, known as the Widower, a handsome and charming serial killer who murdered three of his wives in cold blood. Everything changes when Mark decides to take a new bride.

episodes.name: Denise Glenn
episodes.overview: The student becomes the master when an escaped serial killer from the Pit decides to adopt another inmate's style of killing as a way of paying homage to them.

episodes.name: Tom Beecher
episodes.overview: Bex and the team hunt their most depraved serial killer yet, Tom Beecher, who seeks pleasure in other people's pain.

episodes.name: Jenna Wells
episodes.overview: Bex and the team track the brilliant and beguiling Jenna Wells, the notorious Killer Chemist whose therapy in the Pit has made her even more dangerous and deranged.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a secret prison suffers a mysterious explosion that allows the nation's most violent serial killers to escape, a former profiler is thrust back into a thrilling game of cat and mouse. Alongside a team of soldiers, spies and special agents, she has no choice but to track down and recapture these dangerous criminals… before they kill again.

episodes.name: Ron Simms
episodes.overview: Bex fights to have the team reinstated so they can catch Boogeyman killer Ron Simms, who is currently targeting women searching for love. Time is of the essence to stop him before he leaves more than broken hearts behind.

episodes.name: Adrian Gallo
episodes.overview: The team must hunt down Adrian Gallo, a serial killer who preserves his victims in acrylic resin, the same way people preserve insects. Bex must work alongside a detective from Adrian's past in the hopes they can find him.

episodes.name: Zack Lang
episodes.overview: Bex races to catch Zack Lang, a class-obsessed serial killer who bludgeoned wealthy New Yorkers. When Bex notices a sharp contrast between his victims in the past and present, the team has to dig into Zack's unresolved trauma in order to stop him.

episodes.name: Amanda Weiss
episodes.overview: The team hunts for Amanda Weiss, a killer dubbed the Masseuse, who became famous for breaking the necks of her massage clients. She has kidnapped a woman and, rather than killing her, has even darker plans in mind.

episodes.name: Noah Cyrus
episodes.overview: Two decades after his apparent death, cult leader and serial killer Noah Cyrus appears on the doorstep of one of his followers. Against the clock, the team races to stop Cyrus' plans, but everything is not as it seems.

episodes.name: Lou Kaplan
episodes.overview: A serial killer who targets social media influencers, Lou Kaplan resurfaces, and instead of killing influencers, he collaborates with them. The team tries to combat Lou's mastery of technology and manipulation.

episodes.name: Sidney Fairfax
episodes.overview: The team pursues Dr. Sidney Fairfax, a twisted neuroscientist who mutilates the brains of his victims. As the case unfolds, Bex realizes the doctor may have not only the key to larger mysteries surrounding the Pit, but insight into Shane's past.

episodes.name: Elliot Carr
episodes.overview: Bex and the team hurry to catch Elliot Carr, a high-end shoemaker and serial killer known as the Connecticut Cobbler. Elliot has a fresh approach that the team must figure out before more people find themselves flayed.

episodes.name: Colette Akins
episodes.overview: Bex and the team hunt for a woman whose time working at her father's mortuary business led to chemical overexposure and in turn, auditory psychosis that led her to become a serial killer. Now escaped from The Pit, she’s craving the comfort of a particular voice… and will do whatever it takes to find it.

shows.title: The Hunting Party

shows.name: The Iron Heart
shows.overview: An undercover agent goes on a dangerous mission to bring down a crime ring. Fueled by a bitter and painful past, he along with his allies faces the grueling task that will challenge his resolve and strength.

episodes.name: Core of Iron
episodes.overview: Taking his father’s words to heart, Apollo uses his unexplainable strength for good. One day, their simple life takes a dark turn following a violent encounter with drug addicts. Apollo later receives an enticing offer from a total stranger.

episodes.name: The Calling
episodes.overview: Apollo gets forced to choose between love and duty as he receives his first mission as a top secret agent. Amid his preparations, his strength and principles are put to the test when a group of unknown men abducts him.

episodes.name: Hit the Mission Road
episodes.overview: As part of his mission to bring down Tatsulok, Apollo throws his promising life away and enters jail to penetrate the notorious drug syndicate. Following her painful reunion with Apollo, Cassandra receives unexpected houseguests.

episodes.name: The Breakout
episodes.overview: Apollo manages to worm his way into Tatsulok following his escape from prison. Not wanting her sister to experience what she went through, Cassandra takes Lia in when their mother decides to leave again.

episodes.name: Up the Ladder
episodes.overview: Apollo foils Sol's mission. Soon, the secret agent finds an opportunity to work his way up when the unsuspecting Janus chooses him to participate in combat and appease their enraged bosses.

episodes.name: Inked
episodes.overview: Apollo displays his impressive fighting skills during the combat, capturing the Engineer’s interest and getting himself the official Tatsulok mark. The attention Apollo is receiving, however, sparks jealousy among one of the syndicate members.

episodes.name: Rising Leader
episodes.overview: Apollo rises through the ranks but at the expense of his personal life as Cassandra tries to start anew without him. The dela Torre's celebration of success turns into Priam's worst nightmare when the undercover agent strikes against them.

episodes.name: Period of Peace
episodes.overview: As the word gets around that the Engineer is dead, Priam lets the CIB raid his businesses easily while he plans his next move. Believing that his mission is finally over, Apollo goes back to Cassandra, asking to give their love another chance.

episodes.name: Payback
episodes.overview: As Apollo begins planning for their future together, Cassandra volunteers to join him in his meeting with Helen. However, all hell breaks loose when a vengeful Priam decides to strike back following his son's death.

episodes.name: Cassandra's End
episodes.overview: Tatsulok wreaks havoc as the grieving Priam exacts ruthless revenge for Jason's demise. To Apollo's horror, Cassandra gets caught in the chaos, giving the undercover agent another reason to take down the syndicate.

episodes.name: Assembly of the Wicked
episodes.overview: With a heavy heart, Apollo returns to the syndicated world with a mission to end the evil that Priam is. The Engineer calls in reinforcements to make sure that his son's killer will pay. Eros is eager to impress Priam and replace Jason as his heir.

episodes.name: The Manhunt
episodes.overview: Suspicious of his own men's loyalty, Priam orders Tatsulok's high-ranking members to find the person responsible for Jason's death. Venus ensures her father’s safety inside prison and recalls how she started making a living through schemes.

episodes.name: A New Task
episodes.overview: As Apollo showcases his impressive skills in combat, John begins to see the undercover agent as a threat to his position and excludes him from the group's important task. Eros brews a sinister plan to win over Priam's trust.

episodes.name: First Skirmish
episodes.overview: Wanting to get her father out of prison, Venus banks on her trickery to earn money for a lawyer. Apollo clashes with Eros as they both go after the shipment, while Nyx grabs the opportunity to outsmart John's group.

episodes.name: In His Arms
episodes.overview: John lashes out at Poseidon upon learning that he failed to carry out their group's mission. Apollo gets into a fight with their leader when the latter tries to take advantage of a woman who turns out to be Bungo's daughter.

episodes.name: New Pair of Eyes
episodes.overview: Poseidon finds himself at the receiving end of his boss’ wrath after Apollo saved Venus from John. Priam assigns a secret ace to be his new pair of eyes in the investigation of Jason’s death.

episodes.name: Roles to Undertake
episodes.overview: Apollo urges Venus to quit her work in the fighting arena. Hermes gets a lead in the investigation that points the bombing to CIB. Eros receives a rewarding consequence after facing the Engineer's fury for crossing John's group.

episodes.name: Delos
episodes.overview: Venus grows more determined to get Bungo out of prison after learning of his worsening health condition. Apollo pursues a new lead about Priam's illegal operations, but an oblivious Poseidon insists on tagging along with him.

episodes.name: The Bug
episodes.overview: Apollo grows suspicious of Delos' dire agricultural state and soon sets out to kill Priam despite Helen's warning. However, the undercover agent chances upon Eric, a young scientist trying to escape from armed men.

episodes.name: Uncovering Evidence
episodes.overview: Learning about the cause of Delos' dying root crops, Apollo thinks of a plan to save a group of young scientists being held captive in a laboratory. Eros senses something amiss with Arcadia's new casino player.

episodes.name: Plan of Action
episodes.overview: Enraged over Eric's betrayal, Damon gives the other scientists an ultimatum to complete their task. Eros attempts to uncover the truth behind Hermes' hidden motives. Apollo resolves to fight for the greater good.

episodes.name: A Day of Trade Offs
episodes.overview: Venus shows Eros what she can do for him and asks for a huge favor. Penelope gets the experiment done in hopes of freedom, only to fall for Damon's lies. Unknown to the enslaved scientists, help is coming their way.

episodes.name: One Wins, Some Fail
episodes.overview: After saving the scientists, Apollo sets the laboratory on fire in a bid to stop the disastrous bug experiment from materializing. Venus makes use of her charms and wit to get information from Hermes.

episodes.name: Realizations
episodes.overview: Venus refuses to give up on her deal with Eros. Priam fumes upon learning of Damon's failed bug experiment, instructing Hero to find the traitor in their organization. Poseidon grows suspicious of Apollo's true motive in coming to Delos.

episodes.name: Dose of Your Own Medicine
episodes.overview: Apollo saves Penelope and the group of farmers from Damon as the evil landowner exacts revenge for Tatsulok's failed bug experiment. Venus finds herself in a tight spot when Hermes catches her hiding in his van.

episodes.name: Covert Identity
episodes.overview: As thanks for defeating Damon and protecting the people of Delos, Penelope gives Apollo a special gift. Eros attempts to get the truth out of Hermes by challenging the latter to a game of poker.

episodes.name: Caught Up
episodes.overview: A bloody confrontation ensues between Hermes and Eros after the former CIB agent gained a piece of evidence against the casino owner. Much to Nyx's distress, Eros receives an urgent summon.

episodes.name: Interrogation
episodes.overview: Eros faces interrogation as Hermes' death leads Priam to suspect him. Venus' attempt to improve her father's living conditions in prison backfires. Apollo receives an unexpected visit from Helen.

episodes.name: Promises
episodes.overview: Venus confronts Eros about their deal. While Apollo faces problems at home, the casino owner-slash-secret agent slowly earns Priam's trust and gets tapped for an important task. Juno breaks into tears upon seeing Hermes' lifeless body.

episodes.name: The Other Agent
episodes.overview: Bent on completing his mission as a secret agent at all costs, Eros takes charge of John's group. Tatsulok's remaining high-ranking members gird their loins against the traitor lurking freely in their organization.

episodes.name: The Engineer's Second Soldier
episodes.overview: Tensions start to rise as Apollo's group ends up under Eros' supervision. While Priam pressures Athena to perfect Tatsulok's new experiment as soon as possible, Apollo vows to bring them down by exposing their illegal activities.

episodes.name: Warnings and Red Flags
episodes.overview: Juno vows to avenge Hermes' death. Priam's unusual behavior alarms Tatsulok's high-ranking members. While Eros zeroes in on Apollo, the oblivious undercover agent sets out to thwart Athernity's sinister plans.

episodes.name: Connected After All
episodes.overview: As a senator presses her to unmask CIB's agent in Tatsulok, Helen puts her career on the line to keep Apollo's mission hidden. Eros learns of Venus' connection with Apollo. Selene asks Priam about his secret plans.

episodes.name: Business Continuity
episodes.overview: Apollo saves Helen from a group of men trying to abduct her. Despite the break-in, Athena carries on with Priam's plans. Eros seeks Venus' expertise to obtain information about Olimpio, only to get confronted with Hermes' death.

episodes.name: A Time to Phish
episodes.overview: Eros tries to persuade a reluctant Venus to accept his new job offer, while Apollo learns pieces of information about his boss. Delia finds ways to raise money for Athernity's million-worth product.

episodes.name: The Magic Drip
episodes.overview: Helen and her team storm Athena's building to look for pieces of evidence against Athernity. Wanting to ensure the safety of his aunt who is about to receive the magic drip, Apollo goes against Helen's orders and takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.name: What Comes After
episodes.overview: Apollo infiltrates Athernity to save Delia and its other clients from the magic drip, while Athena faces Priam's wrath as the Engineer's plans fail anew. Nyx grows alarmed at the sight of Hermes' van in Arcadia.

episodes.name: Need to Know More
episodes.overview: Helen puts the senator on the spot as he confronts her over the raid operation against Athernity. While Eros asks around regarding Olimpio, Venus approaches the unsuspecting agent. Juno sets out to seek justice for Hermes' death.

episodes.name: The Snitch
episodes.overview: While Eros inspects Athernity’s office to investigate the aftermath of the snitch's intrusion, Apollo sneaks into Athena’s home to plant some bugs around to spy. Meanwhile, Athena reports some good news to Priam.

episodes.name: Apollo
episodes.overview: Apollo drops by Venus' place, but he soon rushes home after hearing bad news about Lia. While the undercover agent deals with family matters, Venus stumbles upon the door to Apollo's personal life.

episodes.name: Hurt Not My Famiy
episodes.overview: Apollo walks on eggshells as his family spends time with Venus. Just when Venus thought she had already witnessed enough family drama, Delia suffers a heart attack and gets rushed to the hospital. A violent confrontation ensues between Nyx and Juno.

episodes.name: Sudden Sincerity
episodes.overview: Venus begins to see Apollo in a different light, only to overhear his conversation with Hector. With an ace up her sleeve, Juno tries to strike a deal with Eros regarding Priam and Tatsulok.

episodes.name: No More Guesswork
episodes.overview: Apollo tries to confirm his suspicions about Venus until help amid danger pushes the young woman to confess her true motive in approaching him. Juno proves her sincerity to Eros, only to get outsmarted by the sly casino owner.

episodes.name: Taking Measures
episodes.overview: Venus resolves to keep Apollo's true identity a secret from Eros and tries to quit the job, but her boss gives her a new task. Determined to seek justice for Delia and the other victims, Apollo devises a plan to stop Athernity's evil schemes.

episodes.name: As Feelings Linger
episodes.overview: Bearing in mind Priam's life-long goal, Helen recalls a painful memory from the past. Venus becomes smitten with Apollo's genuine nature, while the undercover agent prepares for his mission against Athernity.

episodes.name: Calm Before
episodes.overview: Eros assigns Apollo to supervise an operation on the very same day as Athernity's party, leaving the latter in a pickle. More troubles arise for Apollo when Venus suddenly appears, begging to tag along. Meanwhile, Selene attempts to impress Priam.

episodes.name: Getting There
episodes.overview: Venus insists on helping Apollo execute his plan against Athernity despite his efforts to keep her out of harm's way. At the party, tension builds up between Athena and Eros.

episodes.name: Atherinity Night
episodes.overview: With Venus and Poseidon's help, Apollo manages to sneak into Athernity's special night to look for evidence against the magic drip. There, Apollo comes to blows with Adonis' right-hand man. Eros carries out his own investigation about Athena.

episodes.name: More Heat than Light
episodes.overview: Eros hunts down the snitch while still keeping tabs on Apollo. A clash soon ensues between the two oblivious secret agents, leaving Nyx wounded. Meanwhile, Venus and Poseidon face serious danger when a fleeing Athena discovers their deceit.

episodes.name: Teaming Up
episodes.overview: While Venus obtains help from a stranger who turns out to be Hermes' wife, Apollo gets severely wounded as he wrestles with Athena. A furious Eros arrives at the barracks looking for Tisoy and Poseidon.

episodes.name: Out of the Bag
episodes.overview: Apollo expresses his gratitude to Juno for nursing him back to health, but soon gets taken aback when she mentions Tatsulok. Meanwhile, Eros wastes no time in reporting to Priam about his encounter with the secret agent.

episodes.name: Safekeeping
episodes.overview: Apollo defies Eros' orders and confronts Helen about CIB's other agents in Tatsulok. As Selene panics over the Athernity owner's disappearance, Athena does the unexpected to ensure that the organization's secret remains under wraps.

episodes.name: Didn't See That Coming
episodes.overview: Not wanting to waste time, Priam appoints a trusted ally to carry on Athena's unfinished serum project. Venus continues to cover for Apollo upon learning more about Tatsulok through Juno's eyes.

episodes.name: Mad Man's Wrath
episodes.overview: Unaware of Eros' motives, Apollo gets summoned for a mission. Nyx confronts Venus about her dealings with Eros, only to find themselves in the middle of Adonis' war against the Tatsulok spy. Hero learns about Bunggo's special arrangement in prison.

episodes.name: Agent vs. Agent
episodes.overview: Uncovering the truth about each other's identities, Apollo and Eros engage in a bloody skirmish until the news of Venus and Nyx's abduction reaches them. A furious Selene reports Adonis' reckless way of finding the snitch to Priam.

episodes.name: Of Warnings and Cautions
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros form an unlikely pair as they rescue Venus and Nyx from their abductors. Later, Eros finds himself torn between Priam's orders and Apollo's offer of alliance. A masked man threatens the CIB to reveal their snitch in Tatsulok.

episodes.name: Battle of Nerves
episodes.overview: Tatsulok's massive manhunt for the snitch puts CIB and their secret agents in a tough situation. Wanting to change her fate and stand up for what is right, Venus resigns from her job. A new friend welcomes Troy into the world of easy money.

episodes.name: Inceptive Blast
episodes.overview: Following his attempt to call for a truce with Eros, Apollo hatches a plan now that Adonis is beginning to wreak havoc. Troy, meanwhile, witnesses how his new friend operates as an internet troll.

episodes.name: Two Agents Save
episodes.overview: Helen is called to a Senate inquiry as Apollo and Eros race against time to stop Adonis from triggering another deadly explosion. Troy begins to have second thoughts about his new job.

episodes.name: Madness
episodes.overview: While Apollo faces Adonis and his men all by himself, Eros tries to save the people at the port by warning them about the bomb. Priam, meanwhile, orders Romulo to get rid of Adonis.

episodes.name: The Moment of Encounter
episodes.overview: In a risky attempt to come face to face with Priam, Apollo surrenders himself and admits to killing Adonis. Meanwhile, Nyx demands the truth from Eros as she confronts him about his wound.

episodes.name: The New Boss
episodes.overview: Priam unknowingly falls for Tisoy's tricks and gives him a chance to prove his worth after Eros failed to present the snitch. Venus finds herself in danger when a group of Tatsulok members comes chasing after her. Eros' secret boss is revealed.

episodes.name: On One's Guard
episodes.overview: Still doubtful of her friend, Nyx tries to track Eros' whereabouts in a bid to discover the truth about him. Upon learning of Venus' terrifying encounter with some Tatsulok members, Apollo warns her against making contact with Eros and Juno.

episodes.name: Out with the Dead, In with the New
episodes.overview: A new boss comes in as Tatsulok gathers together to hold a funeral for Athena. While Venus receives an unexpected call concerning her father, Hero learns about Bungo's connection to his organization.

episodes.name: Latest Ace
episodes.overview: Apollo seizes an opportunity to uncover Priam's secret project when the Engineer gathers the Tatsulok members to give them reassurance. Meanwhile, Eros deals with a jealous Nyx amid his plans to get on Selene's side.

episodes.name: Torture
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros find themselves in a tight spot after receiving unexpected orders from their respective bosses. Bungo suffers at the hands of some Tatsulok members who are hunting the mole inside the organization.

episodes.name: Break-In
episodes.overview: Wanting to impress their respective bosses, Apollo and Eros find a way to steal Selene's and Orcus' luxury cars. This, however, leads to a confrontation between the two Tatsulok groups. Hero continues to torture Bungo inside the prison.

episodes.name: Brewing
episodes.overview: Venus confronts an inmate whom she believes to be the person behind Bungo's wounded state. Along with Delia, Hector grows worried about Troy when he fails to come home following their heated argument.

episodes.name: Schemes
episodes.overview: After slugging it out in a fist fight arranged by their bosses, Apollo and Eros learn about what happened to Bungo. With Venus relocated to a safer place, the undercover agent resolves to get the clobbered prisoner out of jail.

episodes.name: Plan and Rescue
episodes.overview: While Apollo tries to find ways to sneak Bungo out of prison, Venus discovers Tatsulok's horrifying plan against her father. Maia warns Troy about his new friends upon learning that he ran away from home.

episodes.name: All Hands
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros finalize their plan to save Bungo. Hector and Delia learn about Troy’s suspicious activities. While worrying about her father’s safety, Venus gets an unexpected visitor while staying at Eros’ rest house.

episodes.name: All Ears
episodes.overview: Venus gets to know Nyx a little deeper when the latter surprisingly pours her heart out about her feelings for Eros. Taking the explosion as his signal, Bungo attempts to escape from prison. Elsewhere, Priam arrives for a mysterious meeting.

episodes.name: Saving One Man's Life
episodes.overview: Apollo's elaborate plan of rescuing Bungo succeeds amid the CIB agents' intense face-off with the Tatsulok members. Bent on finding out what his son has been up to, Hector decides to follow Troy.

episodes.name: For A Taste of Freedom
episodes.overview: Waking up out of prison, Bungo thanks Tisoy for saving his life and protecting Venus. Burning with rage after getting scolded by Priam for failing to accomplish his mission, Hero pulls out all the stops as he sets out to find the escapee.

episodes.name: New Beginnings Turning to Endings
episodes.overview: Apollo goes back to his Tatsulok duties following an emotional farewell between him and Venus. Bungo and his daughter, on the other hand, prepare to start with a clean slate.

episodes.name: A Daughter's Pain
episodes.overview: Venus and Bungo continue to run for their lives as Hero's men go after them. The chase ends in tragedy when Hero catches Bungo, making the poor man taste the ruthlessness of a Tatsulok member.

episodes.name: A Moment of Grief
episodes.overview: Hector and Troy incidentally meet at Bungo's wake, giving the older man a chance to talk to his son. After her father's burial, Venus vows to make Bungo's killer pay by working with Apollo in bringing Tatsulok down.

episodes.name: Retribution
episodes.overview: While Venus treads on Hero's heels, Apollo prepares to take down Bungo's killer on his own. Pressured by Priam's high expectations of him, Echo wastes no time in perfecting his new drug.

episodes.name: Change of Plans
episodes.overview: With his finger on the trigger and Hero locked in his crosshairs, Apollo recalls how violence and lack of morals caused the untimely deaths of his loved ones. Venus lands a job at The Narcissus.

episodes.name: Father and Son Dispute
episodes.overview: Eros overhears something suspicious while delivering Tatsulok's funds to Selene. Learning about Hector's doubts on The Narcissus' operations, Apollo vows to save Troy from imminent danger.

episodes.name: Enter the Narcissus
episodes.overview: Apollo enters the dark and addicting clubbing world of Echo and wastes no time in trying to gain the latter's trust. Eros, meanwhile, sneaks into Selene's house in an attempt to uncover the secret she has been hiding in her private room.

episodes.name: Side Job
episodes.overview: While Apollo confirms that the vape juice from Echo's club contains psychedelic drugs, Venus continues to keep an eye on Hero while observing the club's guests. Echo arrives at Orcus' shop with a luxury car in exchange for Apollo's services.

episodes.name: Listening In
episodes.overview: Thanks to the bug he installed at Selene’s place, Eros learns of Apollo's involvement in Echo's upcoming big transaction. Troy returns to The Narcissus and meets Daphne who offers him the coveted vape.

episodes.name: Sudden Changes
episodes.overview: Sudden changes force Apollo to adapt and improvise as the day of Echo’s transaction draws near. Poseidon gets urged by his father to return to whatever unfinished business he has. Selene grows impatient as he continues to monitor Janus.

episodes.name: Danger Ahead
episodes.overview: Eros prepares for his and Apollo's plan, unaware that Nyx is determined to uncover his lies. Maia discovers the secret of The Narcissus upon seeing Troy and Cronus enter the club in broad daylight.

episodes.name: When Things Go "North"
episodes.overview: While Apollo struggles to confirm the exact location of Echo's drug exchange, Eros gears himself up for their plan, unaware that Nyx is tailing him. Venus finds a way to gather evidence of illegal acts inside The Narcissus.

episodes.name: Too Much to Handle
episodes.overview: Despite the obstacles thrown their way, Apollo and Eros manage to make their plan work by switching trucks. Things end in bloodshed at The Narcissus as the partygoers succumb to the destructive effects of the wrongly distributed drug.

episodes.name: Catching Echo
episodes.overview: A gunfight erupts between Echo's group and Mr. Villamor's men after discovering the absence of the promised drug. Later, Eros tries to finish the job without leaving a trace, only to be caught unawares by the arrival of another Tatsulok member.

episodes.name: Part of the Plan
episodes.overview: Getting wind of what happened to Echo’s transaction, Engineer orders his men to look for Tisoy. Apollo strengthens his resolve to push through with his mission as he loses blood following his encounter with the authorities.

episodes.name: Aftermath
episodes.overview: While Eros provides Nyx with an alibi, Apollo tries to protect his identity by narrating Echo's foiled transaction and their encounter with CIB to Priam. Maia, Troy, and Cronus decide to seek professional help to recover from their trauma.

episodes.name: What Really Happened
episodes.overview: A new position at Metafora welcomes Apollo following his seemingly heroic stunts to protect Echo. A positive change in Janus' vital signs renews Selene's hope in finding out the identity of the snitch.

episodes.name: What Surprised Them
episodes.overview: Apollo gets to spend some time away from his Tatsulok duties, unaware of the shocking situation waiting for him at Metafora. With orders from Priam, Hero leads a team to shut down Echo’s drug lab.

episodes.name: When Everybody is on the Move
episodes.overview: Apollo arrives in the nick of time to save Poseidon's skin from Orcus. Priam resorts to threats in order to settle Echo's case. Puzzled about the mysterious shell Hermes left behind, Juno tries to crack its code with all her might.

episodes.name: Who Finds What
episodes.overview: Apollo informs Helen about his plan to replace Hero as Priam’s right hand. Juno asks Venus to help her decode Hermes’ puzzle. Eros spots Hero’s men transporting a large sum of money.

episodes.name: When Someone Knows
episodes.overview: A new team is formed as Apollo, Venus, Poseidon, and Juno put their heads together in an attempt to uncover the meaning behind the shell's inscription. Eros takes advantage of his new assignment to learn more about Selene's secret patient.

episodes.name: Hyperion Virus
episodes.overview: Janus wakes up from coma wanting to know Selene’s plans for him. Hero finds a mysterious flash drive inside his car. Priam gives a name to the revolutionary virus as his group nears the completion of its antidote.

episodes.name: Bringing the Pieces Together
episodes.overview: Apollo's plan to pit Orcus and Hero against each other starts to work. Eros finds himself on the verge of having his cover blown as Nyx pieces things together from her investigation. Venus and Juno find a lead on Priam's secret project.

episodes.name: About to Sink
episodes.overview: Eros expresses his worry over Venus' plan to deal with Captain Nebres herself. Venus, on the other hand, persuades Apollo to teach her how to fight. Troy goes back home after a heated argument with Cronus.

episodes.name: Venus 2.0
episodes.overview: Eros is left speechless when Nyx accepts Selene’s offer to manage her resort, unaware of the real motive behind his right hand’s move. Apollo trains Venus how to fight as part of the latter’s goal to bring Tatsulok down.

episodes.name: The Boat is Sinking
episodes.overview: Orcus and Hero try to frame up each other. Venus pushes through with her own plan against Captain Nebres, taking Apollo and Eros by surprise as they resolve to take down the same enemy.

episodes.name: Attempt Thwarted
episodes.overview: Things get out of hand as Venus' plan against Captain Nebres goes awry, putting her life in grave danger. This leads Apollo, Eros, Juno, and Poseidon to take action and come to Venus' rescue.

episodes.name: Committed to the Job
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros try to squeeze some information out of Captain Nebres about Priam's secret project. An unlikely team is formed as Venus, Juno, and Poseidon resolve to join Apollo and Eros in their mission to take down Tatsulok.

episodes.name: Putting the Hero Down
episodes.overview: Apollo and his newly-formed team arrive in Palermo Island and soon receive an unexpected welcome from the locals. Back at Metafora, a scheming Orcus manipulates Selene into believing that Hero is a traitor.

episodes.name: A Father's Story
episodes.overview: Priam relocates his lab to avoid the snitch. Terro stuns Apollo with his revelation about the latter's identity and connection to the Iron Heart project. Troy makes efforts to reconnect with his family.

episodes.name: What's Left Behind
episodes.overview: Despite some unanswered questions, Apollo's recent discovery fuels his determination to take down Priam and Tatsulok. Cronus' attempt to stop Troy from making an exposé about the troll farm ends up in a fight.

episodes.name: Retaliation
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros watch things go according to their plan as Hero and Orcus confront each other and fight to the death. Soon, however, Apollo is forced to go after Hero, while Eros deals with Orcus.

episodes.name: Justice Served
episodes.overview: Venus thanks Apollo and Eros for avenging Bungo’s death. Engineer decides to head back after getting wind of Hero’s tragic fate. Cronus receives a warning from one of his colleagues as Troy’s exposé sets the internet abuzz.

episodes.name: Connecting the Dots
episodes.overview: As he tries to get to the bottom of Hero's death through Selene and Orcus, Priam starts to have a hunch about the snitch. While cops raid the troll farm's office, Troy and Cronus get chased by unknown men.

episodes.name: The Janus that Got Away
episodes.overview: Janus finds the perfect opportunity to break free from Selene’s clutches. Hector arrives just in time to save Troy and Cronus from Freyja's men. A pair of vengeful eyes secretly watches Apollo from afar.

episodes.name: Finders and Seekers
episodes.overview: Selene hatches a plan to capture Janus and consequently expose the identity of the snitch. Janus, on the other hand, tails Apollo's friends and family as he plots his revenge. Juno discovers another mysterious item among Hermes' files.

episodes.name: Behind the Charity Gala
episodes.overview: While Janus attempts to strike a deal with Priam, Selene proceeds with her plan to smoke the elusive man out through a charity gala. Following the cryptic directions from Hermes' tap card, Juno ends up within her late husband's secret den.

episodes.name: Expected Vacancy
episodes.overview: Tisoy is taken aback when Venus arrives at the charity gala. After summoning all the invited Tatsulok members, Engineer makes a very important proposition to anyone who wants to take the spot Hero left.

episodes.name: Taking the Bait
episodes.overview: Tension rises among the candidates for Hero's position as Priam tests their resolve and loyalty, unaware that it is all part of the Engineer's much bigger plan. Delia and Lia find themselves in danger as Janus begins his evil plan against Apollo.

episodes.name: Out of the Bag
episodes.overview: Priam finally confirms his suspicion about Tisoy being the snitch and immediately orders for the latter's capture. Apollo, on the other hand, rushes to rescue Delia and Lia from Janus.

episodes.name: The Chase Begins
episodes.overview: After accepting Janus' offer, Priam wastes no time in exposing the identity of the snitch to the whole of Tatsulok. With no other way to save his family, Apollo lets himself be at the mercy of Janus.

episodes.name: Rampage
episodes.overview: Janus proves to be a tough opponent as he continues to terrorize Delia and Lia after getting clobbered by Tisoy. Juno finds a way to stall the Tatsulok members hunting Apollo down. Engineer grows suspicious of Eros and Poseidon.

episodes.name: The Mission is Over
episodes.overview: After his men failed to capture Tisoy, Priam orders Orcus and Selene to pull out all the stops to catch the snitch alive. Apollo spirals down into dejection as his loved ones continue to suffer because of his duty.

episodes.name: Grief
episodes.overview: Apollo is left helpless when Helen relieves him from all his duties as a secret CIB agent. The hunt for Tisoy continues as Priam and the rest of Tatsulok exhaust every possible way and lead to find the snitch.

episodes.name: Gone Rogue
episodes.overview: Despite Helen's orders, Apollo stands firm in his resolve to exact revenge on Priam and Tatsulok no matter what it takes. While Nyx remains suspicious of him, Eros finds himself conflicted upon receiving an unexpected advice from Menandro.

episodes.name: Tipped Off
episodes.overview: Priam considers setting a trap in a bid to catch Apollo. Venus and Poseidon find themselves in danger as some Tatsulok members prove to be adamant in tracking them and Tisoy down.

episodes.name: The Next Phase
episodes.overview: Juno arrives just in time to help Apollo, Venus, and Poseidon escape from Orcus' group and later leads her allies into Hermes' secret den. With Apollo's mission compromised, Helen is left with no choice but to order his capture.

episodes.name: Done Brewing the Plot
episodes.overview: Despite losing the government’s support, Apollo resolves to face Priam head on. Eros urges Nyx to stop tracking down Venus, but to no avail. The convoy transferring Echo to another detention facility gets ambushed.

episodes.name: Bad News Comes in Twos
episodes.overview: Cronus finds a safe way to get in touch with Venus and Apollo. Determined to capture Tisoy once and for all, Priam and the rest of Tatsulok lay out a trap that is sure to alarm the elusive snitch.

episodes.name: An Honorable Demise
episodes.overview: Priam's wickedness reaches extreme heights as he sends a devastating message to enrage Tisoy. Fueled by anger and his determination to bring down Tatsulok, Apollo resolves to finally face Engineer.

episodes.name: Bloodshed
episodes.overview: Gunfight ensues as Apollo faces Priam and the rest of Tatsulok who are all eager to take down the snitch with their own hands. Venus, Juno, and Poseidon arrive to help their ally fight Engineer's trusted soldiers.

episodes.name: Retreat
episodes.overview: The authorities arrive just as Apollo reveals to Priam that he knows about the Iron Heart project. Later, an unexpected ally comes to Juno, Poseidon, and a wounded Venus' rescue.

episodes.name: What Is To Come
episodes.overview: Priam orders his top followers to find more test subjects for the Iron Heart project and prevent Tisoy from getting near it. After filling the void left by Helen at the CIB, Menandro issues a stern warning against Engineer.

episodes.name: Meeting the New Deputy Director
episodes.overview: Priam's desire to capture Apollo gets stronger as he sets his sights on finding out the whole truth about the Iron Heart project. Apollo, on the other hand, finally recovers and comes face-to-face with Menandro.

episodes.name: Apollo 5
episodes.overview: Apollo, Venus, Poseidon, Juno, and Eros officially form the group Apollo 5 at the headquarters. While Selene gives Eros the task to gather human test subjects, Apollo wastes no time in devising a plan to stop Priam's Iron Heart project.

episodes.name: Failed Mission
episodes.overview: Selene and Orcus' attempt to fish for more information from Aphro about the Iron Heart project remains fruitless. Believing that the coast is clear, Apollo's team sets out to abduct Aphro, unaware that Echo got wind of their plan.

episodes.name: When Information is the Key
episodes.overview: Apollo urges Eros to use Nyx to get more information about Priam and the Iron Heart project, leaving the other Tatsulok mole conflicted. Troy and Cronus find a way to help Apollo's team clear their names.

episodes.name: Acquiring Intel
episodes.overview: Eros begins breaking down Nyx’s wall in a bid to acquire intel on Priam’s schemes. Selene sets her sights on Cali after failing to get information about the Iron Heart project from Aphro.

episodes.name: Track Down
episodes.overview: Despite successfully luring Nyx into spending time with him, Eros struggles to obtain any information about Priam and his project. Apollo and his team race against time as an oblivious Cronus gets tracked down by Echo's men.

episodes.name: Cutting the Chase
episodes.overview: Apollo orders his team to retreat when Echo arrives with the intent of finishing him off once and for all. Desperate for information, Selene resorts to intimidation as she coerces Kali to divulge everything about Priam's Iron Heart project.

episodes.name: Closing In
episodes.overview: Apollo's team heads back to their headquarters after rescuing Cronus, unaware that Adonis is following their trail after putting a tracker on Juno's car. Later, Apollo is left frustrated after a meeting with Menandro about their next move.

episodes.name: Hyperion Vaccine
episodes.overview: While Priam boasts about the Hyperion vaccine’s efficacy to the Tish representative, Apollo's team gears up for their mission to infiltrate the Iron Heart project laboratory. Eros continues his efforts to gain Nyx's trust.

episodes.name: Access Denied
episodes.overview: As part of his mission to get information about the Iron Heart project, Eros puts a bugging device on Nyx’s bag. Things are going smoothly until Priam’s aide heads to his lab and sets off the alarm, inevitably putting the Apollo 5’s mission in peril.

episodes.name: Disclosure
episodes.overview: Nyx attempts to convince Priam of her innocence and loyalty without exposing Eros' true color. The Apollo 5 finds out the truth about the Iron Heart project, oblivious to the danger lurking around them.

episodes.name: Target Point
episodes.overview: Adonis finally finds the Apollo 5's headquarters. Apollo strikes a deal with Kali to know Tatsulok's next moves. A violent and emotional confrontation ensues between Eros and Nyx.

episodes.name: Another Cover Blown
episodes.overview: Eros fights for his life against Romulo's men after getting exposed as the other snitch. Apollo's team steps right into Adonis’ explosive trap. Priam orders Aphro to get rid of Kali.

episodes.name: Sustained Injuries
episodes.overview: Apollo and his team manage to get out of their headquarters alive, but Adonis remains determined in finishing them off. Nyx goes back to Priam, ready to receive her punishment. Aphro struggles to obey Engineer's command.

episodes.name: Heightened Emotions
episodes.overview: Emotions get the best of Apollo as he talks to Menandro and Eros about their course of action to stop Tatsulok's destructive project, forcing the CIB head to make a crucial decision. Priam orders his trusted soldiers to eliminate Eros.

episodes.name: Pushing Through
episodes.overview: Despite learning of Apollo's growing doubts about the CIB director, Eros tries to persuade Menandro to keep the former agent a part of their mission. Priam rejoices as he inches closer to reaching his goal of world domination.

episodes.name: Aphro's Destruction
episodes.overview: Driven by her conscience and worry over her sister, Kali discloses Tatsulok's next moves to Apollo. The Apollo 5 then races against time to stop Priam's wicked plot to spread the hyperion virus all over the world.

episodes.name: An Angry Outburst
episodes.overview: Apollo's team rushes to rescue Kali and the people trapped inside the Tatsulok lab. However, their mission proves to be challenging as Priam moves to destroy every piece of evidence of his evil project.

episodes.name: Thwarting an Evil Plan
episodes.overview: Eros confronts Menandro for leaving the Apollo 5 helpless against Priam's schemes. Later, Kali and Apollo's team try to stop the virus from spreading by contacting Karen, unaware that Engineer and his soldiers are tracking the subject's movements.

episodes.name: Sitio Tartaros
episodes.overview: While Selene's and Orcus' groups track down Karen, the Apollo 5 wastes no time in getting to Conrad. Later, a gunfight ensues when Apollo's team encounters Tatsulok.

episodes.name: Infected
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros find themselves fighting against familiar faces upon coming across their former colleagues in Tatsulok. Kali finally manages to communicate with Karen, but unfortunate news gets in the way of their reunion.

episodes.name: Unwavering Resolve
episodes.overview: Apollo resolves to honor his vow to protect the lives of innocent people as he rejects Eros’ rational yet heartless suggestion to stop the spread of the Hyperion virus. Priam tells Nyx why he is not letting Selene handle the Iron Heart project.

episodes.name: Race Against Escape
episodes.overview: With the help of Penelope's team, Kali continues her attempts to recreate the Hyperion virus vaccine. Bent on getting to Argovia, Conrad disregards the Apollo 5's warnings and tries to escape.

episodes.name: Viral Tensions
episodes.overview: Apollo's life is put at risk after trying to stop Conrad from leaving the country. Priam soon learns of the incident and orders his men to keep a close eye on the infected subjects.

episodes.name: Battling Infection
episodes.overview: Apollo's team and the scientists working on the vaccine receive much-needed assistance from the government. Apollo still shows no symptoms of the Hyperion virus despite Conrad and Karen’s worsening state, leaving Kali baffled.

episodes.name: Love, Loss, and Looming Shadows
episodes.overview: Venus' overwhelming concern for Apollo forces her to confess her feelings, oblivious to an enemy's prying eyes in the shadows. Things take a turn for the worse as the virus takes a toll on Conrad.

episodes.name: Aries dela Torre
episodes.overview: Eros, Venus, and Poseidon begin connecting the dots upon learning that Apollo tested negative for the Hyperion virus. Hector pays his nephew a visit, leaving an envelope containing shocking information about the fate of a baby named Aries dela Torre.

episodes.name: Saving Venus
episodes.overview: Despite the recent revelations, Apollo delights in Kali's discovery that his blood could be the answer to their problems. Later, however, an enemy seeking revenge finds the perfect person to use against Apollo.

episodes.name: Revelations and Rescues
episodes.overview: Apollo looks for a way to save Venus from the brutal contraption Adonis made in the name of vengeance. Juno and Poseidon break out in a cold sweat as the spread of the Hyperion virus looms over the horizon.

episodes.name: Priam's Firstborn
episodes.overview: While Menandro tries to stop the Hyperion virus from spreading outside Hellas, Priam safely arrives in Italy before his trip to Tish. His smooth-sailing journey, however, makes a shocking turn when he receives Diana’s last audio log.

episodes.name: Father and Son Moment
episodes.overview: Apollo reaches out to Priam as he takes advantage of his blood relationship with him, hoping to put an end to the Hyperion virus crisis. Menandro senses something amiss upon learning that Apollo has flown to Italy.

episodes.name: Conflict and Contagion
episodes.overview: Setting foot in Italy, Apollo begins to doubt Priam’s intentions when two suspicious men attempt to seize him. Another soul succumbs to the Hyperion virus as the Philippine government ramps up its efforts to contain the contagion.

episodes.name: Deception and Pursuit
episodes.overview: While Apollo falls victim to deceitful Italian goons, Eros and Menandro arrive in Italy to join the search for Engineer and his son. A misunderstanding between Nyx and Romulo leads to a violent confrontation. Selene demands the truth from Priam.

episodes.name: Crossroads of Destiny
episodes.overview: Orcus and Selene abduct Venus and Kali. Juno faints while attending to Poseidon. Priam resolves to delay his trip to Tish in a bid to meet up with Apollo, unaware that Eros and Menandro are following his son.

episodes.name: Clashing Loyalties
episodes.overview: Priam’s reunion with his long-lost son escalates into a gunfight when Apollo rejects his offer to join his side. Panic creeps into Selene’s psyche when Venus tells her that she is already infected with the Hyperion virus.

episodes.name: A Son's Stand, A Father's Death
episodes.overview: While Selene makes her stand, Juno and Poseidon cling to the hope that Apollo will succeed in finding a cure for Hyperion. Apollo's steadfast resolve, however, pushes Priam to do the unthinkable, until Eros intervenes.

episodes.name: Mission Accomplished
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros finally accomplish their mission to defeat Priam and secure the vaccine. While the CIB celebrates its success, Apollo chooses to live a simple life with his family. Meanwhile, Hector attends a religious gathering.

episodes.name: A New Chapter Begins
episodes.overview: Turning a new leaf, Apollo spends quality time with his loved ones and prepares to look for a normal job. Selene vows to bring Tatsulok back to its former glory. A hooded man gets congratulated for bringing down Priam and his organization.

episodes.name: Altare
episodes.overview: While carefully taking a look at the police operation that interrupted his meetup with Troy and Cronus, Apollo notices a strange card lying on the ground, unaware that the item’s appearance is a quick prelude to danger for both his allies and foes.

episodes.name: Commando
episodes.overview: Harmonia warns Menandro that Altare, the world’s largest transnational crime organization, has arrived in the Philippines. Orcus is subjected to an unconventional torture method. A cautious Juno asks Apollo to meet her privately.

episodes.name: Juno's Tragic End
episodes.overview: While Apollo grows extremely worried for her, Juno encounters the man who kidnapped Orcus. Despite knowing fully well that it could be a trap, Selene prepares to rescue the abducted Tatsulok member.

episodes.name: Lost Evidence and Silent Secrets
episodes.overview: Apollo notices a group of strange men fleeing the scene moments after Juno’s fall. Selene and her underlings step into a trap as they look for Orcus. Eros resolves to investigate his old ally’s untimely demise.

episodes.name: Defiant Resolve
episodes.overview: Apollo and Eros begin to investigate Juno's case. Selene ends up joining Orcus in captivity and soon faces their eccentric captor. Apollo finally meets Brother Joseph, whose accessory immediately catches the former's eye.

episodes.name: Fate's Web
episodes.overview: Atlas comes up with a brutal way to force Selene, Orcus, and Dylan to join his side. After getting acquainted with Brother Joseph, Apollo grows concerned upon learning that Hector is planning to donate all his properties to Yusebeia.

episodes.name: The Face Behind
episodes.overview: During the CIB’s operation against Atlas’ group, Xenon is left in disbelief upon being greeted by a familiar face before meeting his end. Apollo receives a warning from one of Yusebeia’s devotees following Hector’s anointing ceremony.

episodes.name: Puzzling Passing and Machinations
episodes.overview: Determined to fight Atlas' group for Priam's memory, Selene decides to seek help from a former ally. Brother Joseph takes matters into his own hands as Apollo begins to investigate Yusebeia. Eros gets a new assignment from Menandro.

episodes.name: Double Cross
episodes.overview: Upon hearing Menandro’s thoughts on Juno’s demise, Harmonia resolves to recruit Apollo to be part of her mission to bring down Altare. Selene plans to use Eros against Atlas’ group, unaware of the trap she is about to step into.

episodes.name: Tensions Rise
episodes.overview: Orcus arrives just in time to give Selene an opportunity to escape from Eros and the CIB. Confirming that Apollo is sniffing around Yusebeia, Joseph puts a hit on the former secret agent.

episodes.name: Unraveling Suspicions
episodes.overview: Apollo’s suspicions about Yusebeia grows after the failed attempt on his life. Troy struggles to juggle his job and studies as he tries to fill the role Hector left behind. Nyx escapes out of prison.

episodes.name: Promise of a Good News
episodes.overview: Before heading out to accomplish a secret mission, Nyx promises Selene that she will return with a good news. Apollo learns from Kules that Koa knows a lot of things about Yusebeia.

episodes.name: Yusebia's Secret
episodes.overview: Apollo and Kules' investigation begins to bear fruit as they stumble upon Cora's remains. Just when he decides against seeking additional security measures for Yusebeia, Joseph receives an unexpected call from the police.

episodes.name: Whispers from the Dead
episodes.overview: Eros urges Apollo to distance himself and his family from Yusebeia, but to no avail. After punishing Koa for his recklessness, Joseph threatens Hector with expulsion if the former undercover agent continues to meddle with their affairs.

episodes.name: Unexpected Alliances
episodes.overview: Suspecting that his parents ended up like Cora, Kules undergoes DNA matching with the bones found in Yusebeia. Nyx meets up with Dylan, unaware that the latter is working with Eros. Koa and his men capture Apollo.

episodes.name: Captured and Confronted
episodes.overview: Joseph reassures Eros that he has control over the whole situation involving Apollo, until the ex-CIB agent fights back. A scuffle ensues between Nyx and Dylan when the latter makes his intentions known.

episodes.name: Tides of Deceit
episodes.overview: After seeing Joseph’s true color, Apollo fights tooth and nail as he tries to escape from Yusebeia’s private army. Kules fumes with rage upon finding his mother’s scarf among the pieces of evidence found in the mass grave.

episodes.name: Captive Secrets
episodes.overview: Eros chances upon Nyx. A furious Kules confronts Hera about his parents' deaths, resulting in a bloody altercation between them when the whole truth spills out. Menandro carries out confidential fieldwork.

episodes.name: Of Captive and Clue
episodes.overview: Priam names his price for revealing the things he knows about Altare. Joseph accuses Apollo of murdering Hera. One of Engineer’s puzzles leads Nyx to his lawyer.

episodes.name: Conspiracy Unraveled
episodes.overview: Koa and his men ambush Apollo, only to be driven off by another group that aims to abduct their target. Orcus gets clobbered by Atlas for refusing to spill Selene’s whereabouts. Eros urges Joseph to distance himself from Apollo, but to no avail.

episodes.name: The Heir
episodes.overview: Apollo gets the shock of his life when he meets Priam once again for an absurd assignment. Unbeknownst to the former CIB agent, Joseph finds a way to settle the score with him as the Yusebeia leader publicly accuses him of killing Hera.

episodes.name: Crimson Pursuit
episodes.overview: Apollo storms Joseph’s mansion as he searches for Lia. Selene fumes as she hears the contents of Engineer’s last will and testament. Keeping his end of the bargain, Priam reveals to Menandro the things he knows about Altare.

episodes.name: Fugitive
episodes.overview: By orders of Brother Joseph, Koa ambushes Kules. Hector tries to convince the Yusebeia leader of his nephew's innocence. As news of Apollo's involvement in Hera's death reaches him, Menandro orders Eros to arrest their former agent.

episodes.name: Dawn of a New Era
episodes.overview: An intense chase ensues when Menandro and Eros try to apprehend Apollo. Troy and Cronus get in trouble as they search for Lia. A new era dawns on Tatsulok as it cleans up its ranks, summons its loyal members, and welcomes its new leader.

episodes.name: Ascending to Power
episodes.overview: Selene questions Apollo’s loyalty and leadership, only to be faced with the threat of being marked as Tatsulok’s enemy. Dylan pledges his loyalty to Commando. A group of attractive ladies abducts Kules.

episodes.name: Entangled Loyalties
episodes.overview: Vowing vengeance for Lia's fate, Apollo mobilizes Tatsulok to take down Yusebeia and even the score with Brother Joseph. Harmonia gets ambushed by a group of unknown men, but help arrives in the nick of time.

episodes.name: The Hidden Brew
episodes.overview: After uncovering how Brother Joseph keeps his devotees faithful, Apollo and Tatsulok prepare for an all-out attack against Yusebeia. Hector’s pleas fall on deaf ears as he urges the police to investigate what happened to Lia.

episodes.name: Thanksgiving Mess
episodes.overview: Apollo, Orcus, and Romulo infiltrate Yusebeia in an attempt to abduct Brother Joseph. Eros grows alarmed when an anonymous tip alleging Yusebeia's illegal activities prompts the CIB to launch an investigation.

episodes.name: Rings of Fate
episodes.overview: Brother Joseph flees from Yusebeia and heads to his safe house where he is keeping his captive. While batting Altare’s men, Apollo recalls the day Juno died upon seeing Atlas’ ring.

episodes.name: Deep Ties
episodes.overview: Eros and his subordinates resolve to punish Brother Joseph for violating the Altare code. Lia remains in captivity while her family prepares to relocate. Apollo finds an opportunity to gain information on Atlas’ connection with the sect leader.

shows.title: The Iron Heart

last_episode_to_air.name: Everything Trying
last_episode_to_air.overview: Sidney and Havlock risk it all to gain possession of the archive. Frank sets out on a life-saving mission.

shows.name: The Last Frontier
shows.overview: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

episodes.name: Blue Skies
episodes.overview: An unprecedented emergency sends Fairbanks into lockdown. Frank gathers every resource available to mount a full-scale response.

episodes.name: Wind of Change
episodes.overview: Luke tries to get back home as the manhunt for Havlock intensifies. Frank weighs whether he should give in to a set of demands.

episodes.name: Country as F**k
episodes.overview: Sarah's disappearance adds urgency to Frank's search. Havlock's master plan takes an unexpected turn, increasing the number of hostages.

episodes.name: American Dream
episodes.overview: A state trooper goes missing, widening Frank's investigation. Armed locals join the manhunt. Sarah grows concerned over Luke's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Arnaq
episodes.overview: Frank focuses on tracking down Luke. The CIA's involvement ramps up as Havlock's plan enters a new phase.

episodes.name: The Devil Wears a Suit and Tie
episodes.overview: Fairbanks is hit with a mass power outage. Sarah spots someone suspicious in the ER. Sidney tries to get control of a key piece of evidence.

episodes.name: Change of Time
episodes.overview: A mysterious new suspect is interrogated. Frank's secret comes to light. Havlock works on retrieving the contents of his hard drive.

episodes.name: L'air Perdu
episodes.overview: Sidney learns about her father's past, the Atwater Protocol, and the classified intel in Archive 6.

episodes.name: Converge

shows.overview: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. He is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made, forming a new team of Librarians.

episodes.name: And the Deadly Drekavac
episodes.overview: When a Librarian from 200 years ago reappears today, he brings back to life a long-closed magical Library and accidentally resurrects an evil Drekavac. The Librarian, along with a quickly assembled team, must stop the Drekavac before it can kill and multiply.

episodes.name: And the Dance of Doom
episodes.overview: Our newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious "dancing sickness," leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

episodes.name: And the Ghost Train
episodes.overview: Half of the team becomes trapped on a runaway ghost train, and the rest of the team must help solve the unresolved business of the ghosts on board.

episodes.name: And the Thief of Love
episodes.overview: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake.

episodes.name: And the Memory Crystal
episodes.overview: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

episodes.name: And the House of Cards
episodes.overview: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunnit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

episodes.name: And the Con-Con
episodes.overview: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

episodes.name: And the Hangover from Hell
episodes.overview: After a wild bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

episodes.name: And the Feast of the Vampir
episodes.overview: While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

episodes.name: And Going Medieval
episodes.overview: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847 (via a homemade time machine), he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and ... Elaine.

episodes.name: And the Graffiti of the Gods
